entries.translation: Njohi ya rum no ĩnyuwo ĩĩ wiki, na barabu, kana ĩrĩ na mũtukanio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.
entries.translation: Kwĩna mĩthemba mĩingĩ ngũrani ya njohi ya rum, oo ĩmwe yayo ĩrĩ na mĩcamo ya mwanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular types of rum include light rum, dark rum, and spiced rum.
entries.translation: Ĩmwe ya mĩthemba ya njohi ya rum ĩrĩa yũĩkaine mũno nĩ hamwe na ĩrĩa hũthũ, njirũ, na ĩrĩa ĩna indo cia mũcamo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.
entries.translation: Njohi ya rum ĩrĩa hũthũ ĩthondeketwo na cukari na ĩkoragwo na cama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dark rum is made from sugarcane juice and has a richer, more complex flavor.
entries.translation: Njohi ya rum ĩrĩa njirũ ĩthondeketwo na ngogoyo ya igwa na ĩkoragwo na mũcamo mũmatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spiced rum is made with added spices, such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.
entries.translation: Njohi ya rum ĩrĩa njĩkĩre indo cia mũcamo, ta mũndarathini, nutmeg, na clove.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.
entries.translation: Njohi ya rum ihũthĩkaga na njĩra nyingĩ na no ĩhũthĩke harĩ mĩtukanio ngũrani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.
entries.translation: Mĩtukanio ĩrĩa mĩende mũno kuumana na njohi ya rum nĩ hamwe na daiquiri, mojito, na pina colada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can also be used in more creative cocktails, such as the Hemingway Daiquiri or the Painkiller.
entries.translation: Njohi ya rum ningĩ no ĩhũthĩke thĩĩni wa mĩtukanio ĩngĩ, ta Hemingway Daiquiri kana ĩrĩa ya Painkiller.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces of division and hate.
entries.translation: No nginya tũregane na mahinya ma ũgayũkania na rũmena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance.
entries.translation: No nginya tũtuange mĩnyororo ya thĩna na ũrimũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And we must bind ourselves together in a common purpose: to build a better future for Nigeria.
entries.translation: Na no nginya tũnyitane hamwe thĩĩni wa muoroto umwe: nĩguo gũthondeka mũturĩre mwega wa thikũ ciukĩte wa Nigeria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The destiny of Nigeria is not to be a land of division and conflict.
entries.translation: Muoroto wa Nigeria ti gũtuika bũrũri wa ngayũkano na mbaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land of unity and progress.
entries.translation: Nĩ gũtuika bũrũri wa ũrũmwe na ũthii wa na mbere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land where everyone has a chance to succeed, regardless of their background or circumstances.
entries.translation: Ni gũtuika bũrũri ũria mũndũ wothe ena mweke wa kũgacira, gũtekũmakania aumĩte kũ kana maũndũ maria aragerera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But we cannot achieve this future without working together.
entries.translation: No tũtingĩkinyĩra maũndũ maya tũtekũruta wĩra hamwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces that seek to divide us and come together as one people.
entries.translation: No nginya tũregane na mahinya marĩa mendaga gũtũgayũkania na tũnyitane hamwe ta andũ amwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance that hold us back.
entries.translation: No nginya tũtuange mĩnyororo ya thĩna na ũrimũ ĩrĩa ĩtucokagia na thutha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The future of Nigeria is in our hands.
entries.translation: Ũtũũro wa Nigeria wa mahinda mokĩte wĩ moko-inĩ maitũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us reject, break and bind the forces that seek to control and pervert our destiny.
entries.translation: Rekei tũregane, tũtuange na tũohanie mahinya marĩa mendaga kwĩĩgwatĩra na gũthũkangia mũoroto wĩtũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us come together as one people and build a better future for all.
entries.translation: Rekei tũũke hamwe ta andũ amwe na tũthondekete ũtũũro mwega wa matũkũ mokĩte nĩ ũndũ wa andũ othe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Complete your Amazon shopping experience with our new and improved ad service!" the ad read.
entries.translation: "Thingata ũgũri wa indo thĩiniĩ wa Amazon na njĩra ya kũhũthĩra ũtungata witũ mwerũ na mwega makĩria!" itangatho riaandĩkĩtwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "With our service, you'll never have to worry about missing out on a great deal again.
entries.translation: "Kũgerera ũtungata witu, ndũrĩ hingo wagĩrĩirwo gũkorwo ũgĩtangĩka nĩ ũndũ wa kũremwo gũkinyira ũgũri mwega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sit back and relax, and we'll take care of the rest.
entries.translation: Ikara thĩ na ũhurũke, na ithuĩ nĩ tũkũrora maũndũ macio mangĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our service is completely free to use, and it's easy to get started.
entries.translation: Kũhũthĩra ũtungata witũ nĩ tũhũ, na nĩ raithi mũno kwanjia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sign up for an account and start adding products to your cart.
entries.translation: Ingĩra thĩĩni wa akaunti na wanjie gwĩkĩra indo thĩĩni wa gĩkabũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to check out, our service will automatically find the best deals for you and apply them to your order.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa warĩkia na ũrenda kuuma, mũtambo witũ nĩ ũgwetha ũgũri mwega na ũwĩkirie thĩĩni wa indo ĩria warĩkia gwĩtia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So what are you waiting for?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sign up for our service today and start saving money on all your Amazon purchases!"
entries.translation: Wĩyandĩkithie thĩĩni wa mũtambo witũ na wanjie kũhonokia mbeca rĩrĩa ũragũra indo kũgerera Amazon!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the customer clicked on the ad, they were whisked away to a new website.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa mũgũri ahingũrire itangatho riu, nĩ atwarirwo o rĩmwe rũrenda-inĩ rwerũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The website was full of ads for all sorts of products, all of which were supposedly on sale.
entries.translation: Rũrenda rũu rwarĩ na matangatho ma indo cia mĩthemba yothe, indo ĩria ciendagio ciothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer was tempted to buy a few things, but they hesitated.
entries.translation: Mũgũri ũcio nĩ endaga kũgũra indo ciigana ũna, no nĩ amaĩrĩirie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had heard stories about people getting scammed by online ads, and they didn't want to be one of them.
entries.translation: Nĩmaiguite ng'ano cia ũrĩa andũ marahenio nĩ matangatho ma nenda-inĩ, na matiendaga gũkorwo ũmwe wa andũ acio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer decided to do some research on the company that was running the ad.
entries.translation: Mũgũri ũcio nĩ atuire itua rĩa gũthuthuria kambuni iyo ĩria yamemerekagia itangatho rĩu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They found a few negative reviews, but most of the reviews were positive.
entries.translation: Nĩ makorire macokio moru, no maingĩ ma macokio mau marĩ mega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The black dog came to me in the night.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had cold, wet fur and its eyes were like coals.
entries.translation: Yarĩ na guoya mũhehu, mũigũ na maitho mayo marĩ ta makara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It growled at me and I could smell its breath, hot and reeking of death.
entries.translation: Ngui iyo nĩyararamire na nĩndaiguaga mĩhũmo yayo, ĩrĩa yanungaga o ta gĩkuũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that I must run, but my legs were leaden and I could not move.
entries.translation: Ngĩmenya atĩ nonginya hanyũke, magũrũ makwa marĩ maritũ na ndingĩahotire gũthĩĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog came closer and closer, its teeth bared.
entries.translation: Ngui ĩyo ĩkĩnguhĩrĩria makĩria na makĩria, yonanĩtie magego mayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and waited for the end.
entries.translation: Ngĩhinga maitho makwa na ngĩeterera mũico.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I heard a voice.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a woman's voice, soft and gentle.
entries.translation: Warĩ mũgambo wa mũtumia, mũhũthũ na mũhoreru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not be afraid," she said. "I will help you."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I opened my eyes and saw the woman standing in front of me.
entries.translation: Ngĩhingũra maitho makwa na ngĩona mũtumia ũcio arũgamĩte mbere yakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was tall and slender, with long black hair and dark eyes.
entries.translation: Arĩ mũceke na mũraihu, na njuĩrĩ ndaihu njirũ na maitho mairũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wore a white dress that flowed around her like a mist.
entries.translation: Ehumbĩte nguo ya rũnyaga rwerũ ĩrĩa yamũhumbĩrĩte guothe o ta kibii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who are you?" I asked. "I am the Angel of Death," she said.
entries.translation: "Hihi wee ũrĩ ũ?" Ngĩũria. "Nĩĩ ndĩ Mũraika wa Gĩkuũ," akiuga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I have come to take you to the other side." I was not afraid anymore.
entries.translation: "Ndoka gũgũtwara mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ." Ndiacokire gwĩtigĩra rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that the woman would take me to a place where there was no pain or suffering.
entries.translation: Nĩ ndamenyaga atĩ mũtumia ũcio nĩ angĩandwarire kũndũ gũtaarĩ na ruo kana mĩnyamaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took her hand and she led me away.
entries.translation: Ngĩnyita guoko gwake na akĩtongoria njĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we walked, the black dog followed us.
entries.translation: O tũgĩthiyaga, ngui ĩyo njirũ ĩgitũrũmĩrĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm Dr. Boakye, a pediatrician at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.translation: Ndĩ ndagĩtarĩ Boakye, ndagĩtarĩ wa ciana thibitari-inĩ wa ũrutani wa Korle Bu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm here today to talk to you about the new malaria vaccine that's been approved for use in Ghana.
entries.translation: Ndĩ haha ũmũthi kũmwarĩria ciĩgiĩ njanjo njerũ ya malaria ĩrĩa ĩtĩkĩrĩtio kũhũthĩrwo Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I'm not interested in having my children vaccinated.
entries.translation: Baba: Ndĩrenda ciana ciakwa ikorwo ĩkiheyo njanjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that you're concerned, but I'd like to take a few minutes to explain why I think it's a good idea to vaccinate your children against malaria.
entries.translation: Ndagĩtarĩ: Nĩndĩrataukĩrwo atĩ nĩ ũratangĩka, no nonyende kũhũthĩra ndagĩka nini ngĩtaarĩria kĩrĩa kĩratũma njuge nĩ rĩciria rĩega kũhe ciana cianyu njanjo ya malaria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I don't need to be convinced. Malaria is a serious disease, but it's not that common in our village.
entries.translation: Baba: Ndirabatara gũkorwo ngĩĩrwo. Malaria nĩ mũrimũ mũũru mũno, no ningĩ ndũĩkaine mũno thĩĩni wa itũra ritũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's true, but malaria is still a major public health problem in Ghana. In 2020, there were over 24 million cases of malaria in Ghana, and over 4,000 people died from the disease
entries.translation: Ndagĩtarĩ: Nĩ ma, no ningĩ malaria nĩ thĩna mũnene harĩ ũgima wa mwĩrĩ wa mũingĩ Ghana. Mwaka-inĩ wa 2020, kwarĩ na makĩrĩa ma arwaru mirioni 24 a malaria Ghana, na makĩria ma andũ 4,000 nĩ makuire kuumana na mũrimũ ũcio
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: But my children are healthy. They've never had malaria
entries.translation: Baba: No nĩngĩ ciana ciakwa cii na ũgima wa mwĩrĩ. Matirĩ marwara malaria
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good, but it doesn't mean they're immune. Anyone can get malaria, even if they've never had it before.
entries.translation: Ndagĩtarĩ: Ũguo nĩ wega, no ningĩ ti kuuga atĩ matingĩrwarwa. Mũndũ o woothe no arware malaria, ona akorwo ndarĩ arwarwa na hau kabere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "So, I was just on the internet, minding my own business, when I saw this pop-up ad that said I had a virus on my computer.
entries.translation: "Kuoguo, ndĩrarĩ nenda-inĩ, ngĩruta mawĩra makwa, rĩrĩa ndĩronire ndũmĩrĩri ya itangatho ĩria yaugaga atĩ kambiuta yakwa ĩna virus.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I clicked on it, and it took me to this website that looked really official, and it said that I needed to download this software to fix the virus.
entries.translation: No ningĩ ngĩmĩhingura, na ĩkĩndwara rũrenda-inĩ rũrĩa ruonekaga rwĩ rwa bata, na yaugaga atĩ nĩbatie kwĩgwatĩra programu ĩyo nĩguo kũhũrana na virus ĩyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So I did, and I installed it, and then it started filling my computer with all this malware.
entries.translation: Kuoguo ngĩka ũguo, na ngĩmĩgathika, na thutha ũcio ĩkianjia kũihũria kambiuta yakwa na virus njũru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I tried to uninstall it, but it wouldn't let me.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I finally had to take my computer to a repair shop, and they had to wipe the whole thing and reinstall Windows.
entries.translation: Mũthiya no mũhaka ĩngĩatwarire kambiuta yakwa nduka-inĩ ĩgaturwo, na no mũhaka mangĩarutire programu iyo yothe na mekĩre mũtambo wa Windows rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, that's why I'm always so careful about clicking on pop-up ads.
entries.translation: Kũoguo, kĩu nĩkĩo gĩtũmi kĩa niĩ gũkorwo na ũbacirĩri rĩrĩa ngũhutia ndũmĩrĩri icio cia itangatho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You never know what they're going to do.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could be filled with malware, or they could steal your personal information.
entries.translation: No cikorwo ciihũire virus cia kambiuta, kana ciiye maũndũ ma ũhoro waku kĩũmbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just not worth the risk.
entries.translation: No ti ũndũ ũbatiĩ gũkũingĩria ũgwatiinĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever see a pop-up ad that looks suspicious, just close it and don't click on it.
entries.translation: Ũngĩkona ndũmĩrĩri ya itangatho ĩrĩ na ũcuke, mĩhinge tu na ndũkahihinye nĩguo kũmĩhingũra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if you're ever not sure whether or not it's safe, just don't do it.
entries.translation: Na ũngĩgakorwo atĩ ndũrĩ na ũma atĩ ndĩrĩ na ũgwati, ona ndũkanamĩhutie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.
entries.translation: Haha harĩ na nyama ya ngũruwe ĩrĩ na cama mũno kuuma gĩcigo kĩa Lancashire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: 1. Hiũhia riko mbere nginya ũrugarĩ wa ndigirii 180.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.
entries.translation: 2. Ruta maguta nyama-inĩ ya ngũruwe na wũige ngothi ĩyo ũmĩkĩranĩtie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.
entries.translation: 3. Thĩĩni wa mbakũri, tukania hamwe karatarĩ, ũũki mũirũ, thiki, Worcestershire sauce na maguta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.
entries.translation: Haka mũtukanio ũyũ nyama-ini iyo ya ngũrũwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
entries.translation: 4. Igĩrĩra nyama ĩyo itara-inĩ rĩa gũcina na ũmĩcinĩre thĩĩni wa riiko kwa mathaa 2, kana nginya rĩrĩa ngothi ĩgũtuika ya rangi wa thahabu na rĩrĩa nyama yahia yothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.
entries.translation: 5. O nyama ĩyo ĩkĩhĩyaga, tinangia gĩtũngũrũ wega, gĩtũngũrũ thaumu, mahuti ma bay na thyme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is widely regarded as one of the most significant figures in world history.
entries.translation: Nĩ agwetagwo mũno ta ũmwe wa atongoria me bata thĩĩni wa historĩ ya thĩĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was born in 1918 in Mvezo, South Africa.
entries.translation: Mandela aciarirwo mwaka-inĩ wa 1918 kũrĩa Mvezo, Afrika ya Mũhuro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He grew up in a rural village and was educated at a Methodist mission school.
entries.translation: Akũrĩire itũũrainĩ rĩa gĩcagi na agĩthomera thukuru-inĩ wa mĩceni wa Methodist.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After high school, he studied law at the University of Fort Hare.
entries.translation: Thutha wa kũrĩkia mathomo ma thekondari, nĩ athomeire watho yunibathĩtĩ-inĩ ya Fort Hare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1944, he joined the African National Congress (ANC), a political organization that was fighting against apartheid.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 1944, nĩ aingĩrire kĩama kĩa African National Congress (ANC), kĩama gĩa ũteti kĩrĩa gĩakararagia mũthutũkanio wa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was arrested for his political activities in 1962 and sentenced to life in prison.
entries.translation: Mandela nĩ aikirio ngono nĩ ũndũ wa ũteti wake mwaka-inĩ wa 1962 na agĩtuĩrwo kĩoho kĩa maica njera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He spent 27 years in prison, during which time he became a symbol of the anti-apartheid movement.
entries.translation: Nĩ aikarire njera mĩaka 27, ihinda rĩrĩa atũĩkire kĩonereria kĩa ũregani wa mũthutũkanio wa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Mandela was released from prison and elected president of South Africa in 1994.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 1990, Mandela nĩ arekereirio kuuma njera na agĩthuurwo ta mũtongoria wa bũrũri wa Afrika ya Mũhuro mwaka wa 1994.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As president, Mandela worked to unite South Africa and promote reconciliation between blacks and whites.
entries.translation: Ee mũtongoria wa bũrũri, Mandela nĩ arutire wĩra nĩguo kũnyitithania Afrika ya Mũhuro na kũrehe ũiguano gatagati ka andũ airũ na athũngũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also oversaw the end of apartheid and the transition to a democratic government.
entries.translation: Ningĩ nĩ atigĩrĩire atĩ mũthutũkanio ũcio nĩwathira na gũcenjia thirikari na kũmitua ya demokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and has been awarded numerous other honors.
entries.translation: Mandela nĩ mũhotani wa ngoga ya Noble Peace Prize na nĩ atugĩtwo na ngerenwa ingĩ nyingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Thutha wa kuuma thukuru, kaingĩ thiyaga mũciĩ na ngeka wĩra wa thukuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
entries.translation: Thutha ũcio no ndĩrorere TV kana thake mĩthako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
entries.translation: Rĩmwe na rĩmwe nĩ thiyaga gũcera na arata akwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
entries.translation: No tũthie tũkerorere thenema, kana tũthiĩ kĩharo, kana tũthiĩ tũgaikare nyũmba kwa ũmwe witũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
entries.translation: Mĩthenya ya wikendi, kaingĩ ngomaga njereirwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
entries.translation: Ningĩ no thiĩ kũgũra indo, kana kwĩrorera thenema, kana thiĩ museum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also like to spend time with my family.
entries.translation: Ningĩ nĩnyendete gũĩkara na bamĩrĩ yakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
entries.translation: No tũthie tũkarie irio cia hwa-inĩ, kana gũthaka mĩthako, kana twĩrorere tu TV hamwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
entries.translation: Nĩ ndĩrakenera mũno ũtũũro wakwa thutha wa kuuma cukuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
entries.translation: Ndĩ na wĩyathi mũingĩ, na no njĩke ũrĩa woothe ingĩenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
entries.translation: Ningĩ nĩndĩramenya maũndũ maingĩ manjĩgiĩ, na megiĩ thĩĩ ĩrĩa ithiurũrũkĩirie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
entries.translation: Ndĩ na gĩkeno nĩ kuona kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mũtũrĩre-ine wa thutha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.
entries.translation: Kũhũthĩra mohoro nĩguo gũteithia andũ arĩa marĩ na mathina ma ũgima wa meciria nĩ ũndũ mwerũ, no nĩ ũronania gũkũra kwega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.
entries.translation: Mũhiano ũmwe nĩ kũhũthĩra mohoro nĩguo kũheyana mootaro kũrĩ mũrwaru kĩũmbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
entries.translation: Kũgerera kũrora mohoro ma mũrwaru kĩũmbe, atarani no mataukĩrwo wega makĩrĩa mabata mao na mamathondekere mũbango wa ũrigitani wao kĩũmbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũyũ no ũrehe maumĩrĩra mega makĩria kũri arwaru, tondũ kwĩ na ũhotekeku mũnene atĩ nĩmekwĩgwatĩra ũteithio ũrĩa marabatara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
entries.translation: Ningĩ ũthuthuria ũcio nĩ wonanirie atĩ arwaru arĩa maamũkagĩra ũrigiti kĩũmbe marĩ na ũhotekeku mũnene wa kũrigitwo kwa ihinda iraya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
entries.translation: Ũthuthuria ũyũ nĩ mũhiano ũmwe tu wa ũrĩa mohoro mangĩhũthĩrwo nĩguo kwagĩria ũrigitani wa ũgima wa meciria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
entries.translation: O ũthuthuria makĩria ũgĩkagwo ũndũ-inĩ ũyũ, no twĩrĩgĩrĩre kuona ũthii wa na mbere harĩ ũhũthĩri wa mohoro harĩ gũteithia andũ arĩa marĩ na mathina ma meciria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
entries.translation: Mwarĩ wa maitũ nĩ mũrigitani ũrĩa ũhũthagĩra mohoro nĩguo gũteithia arwaru aake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.
entries.translation: Ndiya cia mai matheru ikoragwo irĩ mũciĩ kũrĩ nyamũ na mĩmera ya maĩ-inĩ, kuuma kwĩ tũmahuti tũnini mũno nginya thamaki iria nene na nyamũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique environment of freshwater lakes provides a variety of habitats for these organisms, and the interactions between them are complex and fascinating.
entries.translation: Gĩtũũro kĩu kĩa mwanya kĩa ndiya cia maĩ matheru nĩ gĩtuikaga mũciĩ kũri nyamũ ici, na mĩikaranie ya cio nĩ mĩritu na ya magegania.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking features of freshwater lakes is the presence of a distinct zonation of plant life, which is determined by the depth of the water and the amount of sunlight that reaches the bottom.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũmwe wa magegania wa ndiya cia maĩ matheru nĩ gũkorwo kuo kwa mĩmera ngũrani na ya icigo itigaine, iria imenyekagana kũringana na ũriku wa maĩ na riũa rĩrĩa rĩhotaga gũkinyĩra mĩmera iyo kũu rungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In shallow areas, where there is plenty of light, a dense mat of rooted plants known as a "macrophyte bed" forms.
entries.translation: Mĩmera mĩingĩ ya maĩ-inĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mĩri ĩrĩa yũĩkaine ta "macrophyte bed" nĩ ĩkũraga kũrĩa gũtarĩ kũriku na kũrĩa kwĩ riũa rĩingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This provides a habitat for a variety of invertebrates, fish, and amphibians.
entries.translation: Mĩmera ĩno nĩ ĩtuĩkaga gĩikaro kĩa nyamũ ĩrĩa itarĩ mahĩndĩ, thamaki, na nyamũ cia maĩ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In deeper areas, where there is less light, the water column is dominated by phytoplankton, which are microscopic algae that float freely in the water.
entries.translation: Na kuo kũrĩa kũriku, kũrĩa gũtarĩ ũtheri mũingĩ, maĩ macio makoragwo na mĩmera yũĩkaine ta phytoplankton, ĩrĩa nĩ tũmahuti tũnini mũno tũrĩa tũreraga maĩ igũrũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.
entries.translation: Mĩmera ĩno nĩyo kĩhumo kĩa mũthingi kĩa irio thĩĩni wa iriya, na nĩyo ĩkoragwo mũthingi-inĩ wa mũbango wa irio cia iriya-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fauna of freshwater lakes is also diverse, and includes a wide variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
entries.translation: Nyamũ cia iriya rĩa mai matheru nĩ cia mĩthemba mĩingĩ, na nĩ hamwe na thamaki, nyamu cia maĩ-inĩ, iria itambaga, nyoni na nyamũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fish are the most abundant vertebrates in freshwater lakes, and they play a vital role in the food chain.
entries.translation: Thamaki nĩcio nyingĩ harĩ nyamũ iria ĩrĩ mahĩndĩ thĩĩni wa ndiya cia maĩ matheru, na nĩ cinyitaga itemi rĩa bata harĩ mũbango wa irio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common fish species in freshwater lakes include trout, bass, pike, and perch.
entries.translation: Imwe cia thamaki iria cionekanaga mũno ndiya-inĩ cia maĩ matheru nĩ ta trout, bass, pike, na perch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The stainless steel plate is a good conductor of heat, so it can help to dissipate heat from the fire, while the fire proof rock wool is a good insulator, so it can help to prevent the fire from spreading.
entries.translation: Cuuma iria ikoragwo na chromium nĩ ĩtwaraga mwaki wega, kuoguo no ikuwe ũrugarĩ kuuma mwaki-inĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa guoya ũrĩa ũtahĩtukagia mwaki nĩ insulator njega, kuoguo no ũgirĩrĩrie mwaki gũtherema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, the storage area is also equipped with a fire alarm system, so that if there is a fire, the alarm will sound and the fire department will be notified.
entries.translation: Ningĩ, nyũmba ya kũiga indo nĩ ĩkoragwo na mũtambo wa alarm ya mwaki, nĩguo rĩrĩa mwaki waumĩra, alarm ĩyo nĩ ĩkũgamba na rũhonge rwa kũhũrana na mwaki rũkamenyithio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storage area is also regularly inspected by the fire department, so that any potential fire hazards can be identified and addressed before they become a problem.
entries.translation: Nyũmba ya kũiga indo ningĩ nĩ ithuthuragio na ĩkarorwo nĩ rũhonge rwa mwaki, nĩguo makamenya mogwati ma mwaki marĩa mangĩyumĩria na magathondekwo kaĩra matuĩkĩte thĩna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa gũkorwo ho kwa mĩbango ĩno, nyũmba ĩyo ya kũiga indo nĩ handũ hega na harĩ na ũgitĩrĩ ha kũiga indo cia bata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the fire safety measures, the storage area is also equipped with a security system to protect against theft.
entries.translation: Hamwe na mĩbango ya ũgitĩri wa mwaki, nyũmba iyo ya kũiga indo nĩ ĩgathĩkĩtwo mũtambo wa ũgitĩri wa kũgirĩrĩria ũici.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The security system consists of a surveillance camera, a burglar alarm, and a security guard.
entries.translation: Mũtambo ũcio wa ũgitĩri ũkoragwo na kamera ya kũrangĩra, alarm ya wũici, na mũrangĩri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The surveillance camera monitors the area 24 hours a day, the burglar alarm is activated if anyone tries to break in, and the security guard is on duty to patrol the area and respond to any incidents.
entries.translation: Kamera ĩyo ya ũrangĩri ĩrangagĩra hau mathaa 24 o mũthenya, alarm ĩyo ya wũici yakanaga rĩrĩa kwĩ na igeria rĩa kũrũkia, na mũrangĩri arĩ wĩra nĩguo kũriũnga mwena ũcio na kũrora maũndũ marĩa mangĩyumĩria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these security measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa mĩbango ĩno ya ũgitĩri, gĩikaro kĩu gĩa kũiga indo nĩ kĩega na kĩrĩ na ũgitĩri nĩguo kũiga indo cia bata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook Users Drunkenly Post About Their Lives
entries.translation: Ahũthĩri A Facebook Kwandĩka Ũhoro wa Mĩtũrĩre Yao Marĩ Arĩũ
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook users are getting drunk and posting about their lives, and it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Ahũthĩri a Facebook nĩ mararĩo na kwandĩka igũrũ rĩa mĩtũrĩre yao, na ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũrarehe gĩcanjama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The social media platform has been flooded with photos and videos of people who are clearly intoxicated, and many of them are sharing personal details about themselves that they wouldn't normally share.
entries.translation: Intaneti nĩ ĩihũrĩte mbica na thenema cia andũ arĩa marĩ arĩĩu na ma, na aingĩ a o ni maraheana ndeto cimakoniĩ iria matangĩheana o ũguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some users are concerned that the trend is dangerous, as it could lead to people making poor decisions or doing things they regret.
entries.translation: Ahũthĩri amwe nĩ maramaka atĩ mũtugo ũcio nĩ mũũru, nĩ tondũ no ũtũme andũ matue matua mooru kana gwĩka maũndũ mangĩrira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others are simply amused by the antics of their fellow drunk Facebook users.
entries.translation: Angĩ no kũmakio mamakĩtio nĩ wara wa arata ao ahũthĩri a Facebook.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One user posted a photo of herself passed out on the floor with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even stand up."
entries.translation: Mũhũthĩri ũmwe nĩ atũmire mbica yake mwene aringĩkĩte thakafu-inĩ na akandĩka, "ndĩ mũrĩĩu mũno ona ndingĩrũgama."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another user shared a video of herself dancing on a table while shouting, "I'm the life of the party!"
entries.translation: Mũhũthĩri ũngĩ akĩonania thenema yeke mwene akĩina igũrũ rĩa metha akiugagĩrĩria, "nĩ niĩ muoyo wa igongona!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trend has even caught the attention of celebrities.
entries.translation: Mũtugo ũcio nginya nĩ ũnyitĩĩte mateka arĩa moikaine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Comedian Amy Schumer posted a photo of herself on Twitter with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even spell my own name."
entries.translation: Mũthekania Amy Schumer nĩ atũmire mbica yake mwene arĩ Twitter na mandĩko, "ndĩ mũrĩe mũno dingĩhota ona gũtamũka rĩtwa rĩakwa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook has not commented on the trend, but it's clear that it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Facebook ĩtirutĩte maoni igũrũ rĩa mũtugo ucio, no nĩ ma atĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũrarehe gĩcanjama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Only time will tell whether the trend will continue or fade away.
entries.translation: No kahinda gekuonania kana mũtugo ũcio nĩ ũgũthiĩ na mbere kana ũthire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zambia nĩ bũrũri ũtahakanĩte na iria ũrĩa ũrĩ Afrika ya Mũhuro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia has a population of over 17 million people and a land area of 752,618 square kilometers.
entries.translation: Zambia ĩna andũ makĩria ma milioni 17 na mũgũnda wa kilomita 752,618.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's current president is Hakainde Hichilema, who was elected in August 2021.
entries.translation: Mũtongoria wa rĩũ wa Zambia nĩ Hakainde Hichilema, ũrĩa wathuriruo Mweri wa ĩnana mwaka wa 2021.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hichilema is a member of the United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.translation: Hichilema nĩ mũmemba wa kĩama kĩa United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The UPND is the largest opposition party in Zambia.
entries.translation: UPND nĩkĩo kĩama kĩrĩa kĩnene mũno gĩa ũkararia kũu Zambia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy of Zambia is based on copper mining.
entries.translation: Ũtonga wa Zambia ũhandĩtũo wenja-inĩ wa gĩcango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Copper is the country's largest export.
entries.translation: Gĩcango nĩkĩo kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩnene mũno gĩa bũrũri ũcio kĩrĩa kĩendagio nja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important exports include cobalt, zinc, and lead.
entries.translation: Indo ingĩ cia bata irĩa ciendagio nja nĩ hamwe na koboti, zinki, na mũhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Zambian economy has been struggling in recent years due to low copper prices.
entries.translation: Ũtonga wa Zambia nĩ ũkoretũo ũgĩthĩnĩka mĩaka mĩthiru nĩ ũndũ wa bei cia thĩ cia gĩcango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a member of the United Nations, the African Union, and the Southern African Development Community (SADC).
entries.translation: Zambia nĩ ũmwe wa United Nations, African Union, na South African Development Community (SADC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The signing of Lionel Messi by Paris Saint-Germain sent shockwaves through the world of soccer.
entries.translation: Kwandĩkithio kwa Lionel Messi nĩ Paris Saint-Germain nĩ kwarehire kĩmako kĩnene kũrĩ bũrũri wa mũbira wa magũrũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Argentine superstar had been one of the most coveted players in the world for years, and his arrival in Paris marked a major turning point in the club's history.
entries.translation: Njata ĩyo nene ya Argentina nĩyo yaarĩ ũmwe wa athaaki arĩa merirĩirio mũno thĩiniĩ wa thĩ kwa mĩaka mĩingĩ, na gũkinya gwake kũũrĩa Paris nĩ kũonanirie ihinda rĩa ũgarũrũku mũnene thĩini wa rũgano rwa kĩrabu kĩu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi had spent his entire professional career with Barcelona, where he had won everything there was to win.
entries.translation: Messi nĩ aikarĩte kahida koothe ka wĩra wake na Barcelona, kũrĩa aarĩ ehotanĩire kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩngĩarĩ gĩa kũhotũo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But after a tumultuous few months, he decided to leave the club and sign with PSG.
entries.translation: No thuutha wa mieri mĩnini ya gũtukanio, nĩ atuire itua kuuma kĩrabu kĩu na kwĩandikithia na PSG.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The move was a major coup for PSG, who were looking to add a superstar to their squad in order to compete for the Champions League title.
entries.translation: Gũthama kũu kwarĩ ũtunyani mũnene wa PSG, arĩa nĩ methaga kũongerera njata njorua kũrĩ gikundi kĩao nĩ geetha macindane macindano ma Champions League.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi's signing was met with excitement by PSG fans, who were eager to see the world's best player in action.
entries.translation: Kwandĩkithio kwa Messi nĩ kwanyitirũo na gĩkeno kĩnene nĩ arĩa mendete PSG, arĩa maarĩ merĩgĩrĩirie kũona mũthaki ũrĩa mwega biũ wa thĩ yothe agĩthaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there were also some concerns about how he would fit into the team.
entries.translation: No nĩ kwarĩ na ciũria cikoniĩ ũrĩa angiahotire kũiganĩra gĩkundi-inĩ kĩũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PSG already had a number of talented players, and it was unclear how Messi would be able to work with them.
entries.translation: PSG nĩ yaarĩ na athaaki jorua, na nĩ kũonanagia wega ũrĩa Messi angĩarĩ ahote kũruta wĩra nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of Mice and Men is a novel by John Steinbeck that tells the story of two migrant workers, George and Lennie, who travel together in search of work during the Great Depression.
entries.translation: Of Mice and Men nĩ ibuku rĩa John Steinbeck rĩrĩa riugaga rũgano rwa aruti eerĩ a wĩra ageni, George na Lennie, arĩa mathiaga rũgendo hamwe magĩetha wĩra hĩndĩ ya Great Depresssion.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The novel is set in a time and place where the American Dream is all but dead, and the only way to survive is to stick together and look out for each other.
entries.translation: Ibuku rĩũ rĩandĩkĩtũo igũrũ rĩa handũ na kahinda karĩa Kirooto kĩa Amerika gĩkuĩte biũ, na njĩra o ĩrĩa ĩmwe ya gũtũũra mũoyo nĩ kũũmanĩrĩria na kũgitanĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George and Lennie are both dreamers.
entries.translation: George na Lennie eerĩ nĩ arooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George dreams of one day owning a farm, where he and Lennie can live in peace and harmony.
entries.translation: George arootaga mũthenya ũmwe agĩe na mũgũnda, kũrĩa we na Lennie no matũũre na thayũ na ũiguano.

entries.english: But their plans are once again thwarted when Lennie accidentally kills a woman.

entries.english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.
entries.translation: Mĩthenya ya gũciarũo nĩ ihinda rĩa gũkũngũĩra mũthenya ũrĩa waciarirũo.

entries.english: It is a day to reflect on all the good things in your life and to thank those who have made you who you are.
entries.translation: Nĩ mũthenya wa gwĩcĩĩria maũndũ marĩa mothe mega marĩ mũtũrĩre-inĩ waku na gũcokeria ngatho arĩa magũtuĩte ũrĩa ũrĩ.

entries.english: It is also a day to set goals for the year ahead and to make plans for the future.
entries.translation: Ona ningĩ nĩ mũthenya wa kũbanga maũndũ ma mwaka ũrĩa ũracoka na kũbanga mĩbango ya hau mbere.

entries.english: To make the most of your birthday, start by making a list of all the things you are grateful for.
entries.translation: Nĩ getha wĩĩke maũndũ maingĩ mũthenya waku wa gũciarũo, ambĩrĩria na kũbanga maũndũ marĩa mothe ũracokeria ngatho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include your family, friends, health, home, job, or anything else that is important to you.
entries.translation: Maya no makorũo me hamwe na bamĩrĩ yaku, arata, ũgima wa mwĩrĩ, mũciĩ, wĩĩra, kana kĩndũ kĩngĩ kĩrĩa nĩ kĩa bata kũrĩ wee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.
entries.translation: Warĩkia kũbanga maũndũ mau, oya kahinda ga gwĩciiria igũrũ rĩa o kĩndũ na ũrĩa gĩtũmite mũtũrĩre waku wagĩre makĩria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
entries.translation: Ningĩ, ũbange maũndũ ma gwĩka mwaka ũrĩa ũracoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
entries.translation: Maundũ maya no makorũo o kĩrĩa ũkwenda, na no nginya makorũo matheru, mangĩthimĩka, mangĩkinyanĩra, ma bata, na ma kahinda gakinyanĩru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.
entries.translation: Kwa mũhiano, wahota kũbanga ũndũ wa kũgũithia ũritũ wa mwĩrĩ, kũheo gaturũa wĩra-inĩ, kana gũceera kũndũ kũgeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.
entries.translation: Wa mũico, banga mĩbango ya mũthenya waku wa gũciarũo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.
