entries.translation: Na ngui yaku nayo nĩ ĩrĩkenagĩra ũndũ ũcio wa kũrengwo ndwara!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are a few additional tips for trimming your dog's nails:
entries.translation: Tũtũ nĩtwo tũmaũndũ tũrĩa ũngĩthingata hindĩ ĩrĩa ũrarenga ndwara cia ngui yaku:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Start by trimming the nails on your dog's front paws.
entries.translation: * Ambiriria na ndwara cia magũrũ ma mbere ma ngui yaku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is usually the easiest place to start.
entries.translation: Hau nĩho handũ harĩa harĩ raithi kwambĩrĩria naho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * If your dog is nervous, try trimming their nails one at a time.
entries.translation: * Angĩkorwo ngui yaku ĩna guoya, geria kũrenga rwara rũmwe rũmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be sure to trim the nails evenly.
entries.translation: * Tigĩrĩra atĩ nĩ warenga ndwara ciothe ciiganaine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You don't want one nail to be shorter than the others.
entries.translation: Nĩ getha ndwara imwe itigakũhĩhe gũkĩra irĩa ingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * If you're not sure how to trim your dog's nails, ask your veterinarian or a groomer for help.
entries.translation: * Angikorwo ndũrĩ na ũũma wa ũrĩa ũbataire kũrenga ndwara cia ngui yaku, ũria ndagĩtarĩ wa nyamũ kana mũtaaramu wa gũtheria nyamũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little care and attention, you can keep your dog's nails trimmed and healthy.
entries.translation: Kũrenga ndwara cia ngui yaku na gũciiga irĩ thaka kũrabata o ũbacĩrĩri na kwĩrutanĩria hanini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ivory Coast is a country in West Africa that has been in the midst of a civil war since 2010.
entries.translation: Ivory Coast nĩ bũrũri ũkoragwo Africa ya Ithũĩro ũrĩa ũkoretwo na mbaara cia gĩkabira kuuma mwaka wa 2010.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict began after incumbent president Laurent Gbagbo refused to accept defeat in the 2010 presidential election.
entries.translation: Mbaara ĩyo yaambĩrĩirie thutha wa mũtongoria wa bũrũri Laurent Gbagbo kũrega gwĩtĩkĩra kũhotwo gĩthurano-inĩ kĩa mwaka wa 2010.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo was eventually ousted by forces loyal to Alassane Ouattara, who was declared the winner of the election.
entries.translation: Gbagbo nĩ acookire akĩrutwo waathani-inĩ nĩ mbũtũ cia Alassane Ouattara, ũrĩa watangathirwo ta mũhootani wa gĩthurano kĩu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the conflict has continued, with sporadic violence breaking out in the country.
entries.translation: Ona kũrĩ o ũguo, mbara no ĩthiĩte na mbere na gũtuthũka mĩena ngũrani ya bũrũri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, there were hopes that the country would finally be able to move on from the civil war.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 2017, nĩ kwarĩ na mwĩhoko atĩ mbara cia gĩkabira nĩ igũthira bũruri-inĩ ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, these hopes were dashed when Gbagbo was acquitted of charges of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.
entries.translation: No ona kũrĩ o ũguo, mwĩhoko ũcio nĩ wathirire thutha wa Igooti Inene rĩa Maburi kũruta ndũmĩrĩri ati Gbagbo ndarĩ na mahĩtia thitango-inĩ ya mahĩtia ma kũhinyĩrĩria mũingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo's acquittal was seen as a blow to the peace process, and it led to renewed violence in the country.
entries.translation: Ndũmĩrĩri ĩyo nĩyahutirie mũno thayũ wa mũingĩ, na ĩgĩcocera mbara njeru bũruri-inĩ ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2018, the United Nations Security Council imposed sanctions on Gbagbo and his supporters.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 2018, Kĩama kĩa Ũgitĩri kĩa United Nations nĩkĩarũtire watho wa gwĩkĩrĩra iremithia Gbagbo hamwe na arũmĩrĩri ake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions were aimed at pressuring Gbagbo to end his support for violence in the country.
entries.translation: Mworoto wa iremithia icio waarĩ gũtũma Gbagbo atige kũnyita itemi mbaru mbaara bũruri-inĩ ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions have had some success, and there has been a decrease in violence in Ivory Coast since they were imposed.
entries.translation: Iremithia icio nĩ ciarehire ũmithio na mbara nĩ ĩthiite ĩnyihĩte bũruri-inĩ wa Ivory Coast kuuma rĩrĩa ciekĩrirwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country is still far from stable.
entries.translation: O na kũrĩ o ũgwo, ũgacĩru wa bũruri ũcio ndũrĩ wakinyanĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to do laundry, from using a traditional washing machine and dryer to more eco-friendly methods like hand washing and line drying.
entries.translation: Njĩra nĩ nyingĩ cia kũhuura nguo, no ũhũthĩre macini ya gũthambia na kũmithia nguo o na kana njĩra ingi cia kũrũmbũiya marĩa matũrigicĩirie ta kũhuura nguo na moko na kũmithia riua-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to do laundry without using a machine is to hand wash your clothes in a basin or sink.
entries.translation: Njĩra ĩmwe ya kũhuura nguo ũtakũhũthĩra macini nĩ gũthambia nguo na moko kĩraĩ-inĩ kana sinki-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, fill the basin with warm water and add a small amount of laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Nĩ getha ũhũthĩre njĩra ĩno, ihuria kĩrai na maaĩ mararu ũcooke wĩkĩre thabuni mũnini wa kũhuura nguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Soak your clothes for a few minutes, then scrub them with a washcloth or brush.
entries.translation: Rinda nguo ciaku ndagĩka nini, ũcooke ũcikumuthe na gĩtambaya kana mbũraci.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rinse your clothes thoroughly in clean water, then wring them out.
entries.translation: Kamũra nguo ciaku wega na maaĩ matheru, ũcooke ũhihe maaĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes to dry on a clothesline or drying rack.
entries.translation: Cũria nguo ciaku ciume mũkanda-inĩ kana cũma-inĩ ya kwanĩka nguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another option is to use a washing machine without a dryer.
entries.translation: Njĩra ĩyo ĩngĩ nĩ kũhũthĩra macini ya gũthambia nguo ĩtarĩ na macini ya kũmithia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can save energy and money, but it does require more time and effort.
entries.translation: Njĩra ĩno no ĩguteithie kũhonokia mbeca na hinya wa mĩtambo, no nĩ ĩrabatara mathaa maingĩ na kwĩrutanĩria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To wash clothes in a machine without a dryer, fill the machine with water and add laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Nĩ getha ũhuure nguo na macini ĩtarĩ na mũtambo wa kũmithia-rĩ, ihũria macini na maaĩ ũcooke wĩkĩre thabuni wa nguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Set the machine to the appropriate cycle, then start it.
entries.translation: Ĩkĩra macini gĩthimi kĩrĩa kĩagĩrĩire, ũcooke ũmĩakie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the cycle is complete, remove your clothes from the machine and hang them to dry.
entries.translation: Yarĩkia gũthiũrũrukia, ruta nguo ciaku macini-inĩ ũcianĩke ciume.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you live in an area with a lot of rain, you may be able to use the rain to help you dry your clothes.
entries.translation: Angĩkorwo ũikaraga kũndũ kuuraga mbura nene mũno, no ũhote kũũmithia nguo ciaku na mbura ĩyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes on a clothesline outside in the rain.
entries.translation: Anĩka nguo ciaku mũkanda-inĩ wa nja mbura-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the beginning, there was only darkness.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe was a vast, empty void.
entries.translation: Thĩ ndĩarĩ na kĩndu o na kĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, out of the darkness, came a spark.
entries.translation: Thutha ũcio, kuuma o nduma-inĩ ĩyo, gũkiumĩra thandĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This spark was the first sign of life in the universe.
entries.translation: Thandĩ ĩyo nĩyo yarĩ ndariri ya mbere ya muoyo gũkũ thĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It grew and expanded, becoming a small ball of fire.
entries.translation: Ĩgĩthii na mbere na kũneneha nginya ĩgĩtũĩka kamũbira kanini ka mwaki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ball of fire was the sun.
entries.translation: Mũbira ũyũ wa mwaki nĩguo warĩ riua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Around the sun, the planets began to form.
entries.translation: Hau hakuhĩ na riua nĩho thĩĩ ciothe ciambĩrĩirie gwĩthondeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Earth was the third planet from the sun.
entries.translation: Thĩ ĩno tũikaraga nĩyo yarĩ ya gatatũ kuuma kũrĩ riua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a small, rocky planet with a thin atmosphere.
entries.translation: Yaarĩ thĩ nini ya mahiga, ĩrĩa yarĩ na mũrĩngĩti mũceke wa rĩera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the Earth, the first living things began to appear.
entries.translation: Kũu Thĩ ĩyo nĩkuo indo iria irĩ na muoyo ciambĩrĩirie kuumĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These were simple organisms, such as bacteria and algae.
entries.translation: Indo ici ciarĩ tũnyamu tũnini, ta bakteria na algae.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over time, these organisms evolved into more complex forms of life, such as plants and animals.
entries.translation: O ũrĩa mahinda mathiaga, tũnyamu tũtũ tũgĩcenjia tũgĩtũĩka indo ingĩ irĩ na muoyo, ta mĩmera na nyamũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first humans appeared on Earth about 200,000 years ago.
entries.translation: Andũ a mbere monekanire Thĩ ta mĩaka 200,000 mĩthiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have evolved and developed to become the dominant species on Earth.
entries.translation: Andũ nĩ mathiite macenjetie na makuurĩte magatuĩka nĩo marathana Thĩ iguru rĩa indo irĩa ingĩ irĩ muoyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe is still expanding and evolving.
entries.translation: Thĩ no ĩrathĩĩ na mbere na kwarama na kũgarũrũka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists believe that it will continue to expand for billions of years.
entries.translation: Athomi a Sayansi metĩkĩtie atĩ thĩ ĩgũthĩĩ na mbere kwarama kwa ihinda rĩa mambirioni ma mĩaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will reach a point where it can no longer expand.
entries.translation: Thutha-inĩ, thĩ nĩ ĩgakinya handũ ĩremwo nĩ kwarama rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At this point, the universe will begin to contract.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will collapse in on itself and disappear.
entries.translation: Mũico-inĩ thĩ nĩ kũharagana ĩkaragana yo nyene na ĩthire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the universe may end, the story of life will continue.
entries.translation: No ona gũtwika thĩ yahoota gũgathira, rũgano rwa mũtũũrĩre no rũgathie na mbere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.
entries.translation: Ndĩna kĩmako nĩ ũndũ wa marĩa matũrigicĩirie na ũrĩa ũgarũrũku wa rĩera ũracenjia thĩ ĩno tũikaraga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.
entries.translation: No ningĩ nĩnyendete indo cia kĩĩrĩu na irĩa njerũ ciumĩte, kogwo ndĩracaria njĩra cia kũnyihia hathara ya kaboni ĩtakũhutia mũtũũrĩre wakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.
entries.translation: Nĩkĩo nyendete mũno ũhoro wĩgiĩ gũcaria ihumo ingĩ cia hinya wa mĩtambo ĩrĩa ĩngĩhũthĩrĩka rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.
entries.translation: Hinya wa mĩtambo ũrĩa ũngĩhũthĩrĩka rĩngĩ nĩ hinya ũrĩa umanaga na ihumo iria cierũhagio na njĩra ya ndũire, ta hinya wa riũa, rũhuho na maaĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.
entries.translation: Ihumo icio ingĩ cia hinya wa mĩtambo nĩ irĩa itahũthagĩrwo tene gũthondeka hinya, ta bayomasi na ũrugarĩ wa thĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.
entries.translation: Ihumo cia hinya wa mĩtambo ĩrĩa ĩngĩhũthĩrĩka rĩngĩ hamwe na ihumo icio ingĩ nĩ theru na no ihũthĩke hatarĩ gũthũkia marĩa matũrigicĩirie, ũguo nĩ kuuga atĩ itirehaga rĩera rĩũru na indo ingĩ cia gũthũkia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.
entries.translation: Njĩra ĩmwe ya kũrehe ngũrani nĩ gũcenjia ũhũthĩre ihumo cia hinya ũria ũngĩhũthĩrĩka rĩngĩ gwaku mũciĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.
entries.translation: O ho no ũnyihanyihie gĩthimi kĩa hinya ũrĩa ũhũthagĩra, na njĩra ya gũcomora indo cĩa thitima rĩrĩa ũtaracihũthĩra, kũhoria thitima cia rumu iria ũrauma, na kũhũthĩra indo iria itahũthagĩra hinya mũingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old wooden boat sat on the shore, its sails furled and its hull weathered by the sun and the rain.
entries.translation: Meri ngũrũ ya mbao yaikarĩte hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria, maburi mayo makũnjĩtwo na igathũkangio nĩ riũa na mbura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had seen many years of service, carrying its owners on voyages to far-off lands.
entries.translation: Nĩ yarutĩte wĩra mĩaka mĩingĩ wa gũkua ene yo na kũmatwara thabarĩ na ng'endo cia kũraihu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But now, it was retired, its days of sailing over.
entries.translation: Ĩndĩ rĩu, nĩ yatigĩte kũruta wĩra, matuko mayo ma wĩra nĩ mathirĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young boy named Thomas came to the beach.
entries.translation: Mũthenya ũmwe-rĩ, kamwana kanini getagwo Thomas gagĩũka rũtere-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had heard stories about the old boat, and he was eager to see it for himself.
entries.translation: Nĩ kaiguĩte ng'ano ciĩgĩe meri ĩyo na nĩ keriragĩria mũno kwĩyonera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he saw the boat, he was amazed by its size and its beauty.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa koonire meri ĩyo, nĩ kagegirio mũno nĩ ũnene na ũthaka wayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He could imagine himself sailing off on adventures in the vast ocean.
entries.translation: Gakĩambĩrĩria gwĩciria ũrĩa kangĩkenera kũmĩtwarithia kũu iria-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas asked the owner of the boat if he could take a closer look.
entries.translation: Thomas akĩũria mwene meri ĩyo kana no amĩonere hakuhĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner smiled and said, "Of course you can. Come aboard!"
entries.translation: Nake mwene acanjamũkĩte akĩmwĩra, "ĩĩ hatarĩ nganja. Tonya thĩinĩ!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas climbed into the boat and sat down in the captain's chair.
entries.translation: Thomas akĩhaica meri na agĩikarĩra gĩtĩ kĩa mũtwarithia wa meri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked out over the water and imagined himself sailing away to a faraway land.
entries.translation: Agĩcũthĩrĩria maaĩ-inĩ na agĩciria ũrĩa angĩmĩtwarithia athie thabarĩ ya kũraihu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat watched Thomas for a moment, then said, "Do you want to learn how to sail?"
entries.translation: Mwene meri akĩrora Thoma kwa ihinda, agĩcoka akĩmwĩra, "No wende kũmenya gũtwarithia meri?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Maitho ma Thomas magĩkenga na akĩmũcokeria, "ĩĩ no nyende."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat smiled again.
entries.translation: Mwene meri ĩyo agĩcanjamũka gĩthithi rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scene: Two friends, Jasmine and Joseph, are sitting at a coffee shop.
entries.translation: Gĩcunjĩ kĩa ngerekano: Arata eerĩ, Jasmine na Joseph, maikarĩte thĩ mũkawa-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm so glad you could meet me today, Joseph.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Nĩndakena mũno nĩ gũcemania nawe ũmũthĩ Joseph.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Joseph: Njĩra ũrĩa ũkwenda ngũteithie Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm having a really tough time at work.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Nĩndĩragerera ihinda iritũ mũno wĩra-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure if I'm going to be able to keep my job.
entries.translation: Ndirĩ na ma nĩngũhota gũthiĩ na mbere na wĩra ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so sorry to hear that.
entries.translation: Nĩndaigua ũũru mũno nĩ kũigua ũguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But basically, my boss is really unfair to me.
entries.translation: Na njĩra nguhĩ, mũnene wakwa ndareka wega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's always picking on me and making me do all the worst jobs.
entries.translation: Anyonagĩra o niĩ nyiki na agatũma ndute mawĩra marĩa moru mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And she's not even giving me a fair chance.
entries.translation: Na ndarahe mweke wa gwetha kĩhoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Joseph: Nĩ ũũru mũno ũguo Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can't believe she's treating you like that.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so stressed out about it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't know what to do.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Well, first of all, you need to take a deep breath and calm down.
entries.translation: Joseph: Rĩu-rĩ, wa mbere ũbataire ũhorere na ũtige kũmaka mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The smell of fresh-baked bread wafted through the air as the baker pulled a tray of golden brown loaves from the oven.
entries.translation: Mũtararĩko wa mĩgate mĩruge wega waiyũrĩte rĩera-inĩ hĩndĩ ĩyo mũrugi wa mĩgate akĩgucia tree ya mĩgate mĩhĩu wega kuuma riiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He carefully set them on a cooling rack and smiled, pleased with his work.
entries.translation: Akĩmĩiga handũ harĩa ĩhoragĩra na agĩcanjamũka, nĩ gũkenio nĩ wĩra wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The loaves were perfectly browned and had a delicious aroma that made his mouth water.
entries.translation: Mĩgate ĩyo yarĩ mĩhĩu wega na yatararĩkaga wega, ũndũ ũrĩa watũmaga amerie mata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He couldn't wait to try one!
entries.translation: Nĩ eriragĩria mũno gũcama mũgate ũmwe!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baker cut a slice of bread and took a bite.
entries.translation: Mũrugi ũcio wa mĩgate agĩtinia gacunjĩ ka mũgate ũmwe na akĩrũma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was even better than he had imagined, with a soft, chewy texture and a rich, flavorful taste.
entries.translation: Warĩ na cama mũno gũkĩra nginya ũrĩa eciragĩria, na warĩ mũhũthũ gũtanuka na mũtararĩko mwega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He closed his eyes and savored the moment, enjoying the feeling of contentment that came from eating something so delicious.
entries.translation: Akĩhinga maitho nĩ getha aigue mũcamo ũcio wega, akenete mũno nĩ ũndũ wa gũcama kĩndũ gĩthaka ũguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baker knew that he was lucky to have the ability to bake such delicious bread.
entries.translation: Mũrugi ũcio wa mĩgate nĩamenyaga atĩ ena mũnyaka mũno kũhota kũruga mĩgate mĩthaka ũguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took pride in his work and was always happy to share his creations with others.
entries.translation: Nĩetiyagĩra mũno wĩra wake na nĩakenaga hingo ciothe rĩrĩa aragayana na arĩa angĩ wĩra wa moko make.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of fish you choose will depend on your personal preferences and the intended use for the fish.
entries.translation: Mũthemba wa thamaki ũrĩa ũracagũra ũringanaga na kĩrĩa ũrenda we mwene hamwe na ũrĩa ũrenda kũhũthĩra thamaki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is high in omega-3 fatty acids, then you may want to choose a wild river fish.
entries.translation: Angĩkorwo ũrenda thamaki ĩna gĩthimi kĩa igũrũ kĩa omega-3, ũbataire gũcagũra thamaki ya njũũĩ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically lower in contaminants than farm-raised fish.
entries.translation: Thamaki icio nĩ ikoragwo irĩ theru gũkĩra thamaki cia kũrĩithĩrio mũgũnda-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, wild river fish can be more expensive and difficult to find.
entries.translation: O na kũri o ũguo-rĩ, thamaki cia njuuĩ-inĩ no ikorwo na goro mũno na ikorwo itakuoneka na njĩra ya raithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is mild in flavor and easy to cook, then you may want to choose a calm lake fish.
entries.translation: Angĩkorwo ũrenda thamaki ĩna mũcamo ũigananĩire na ya kũruga na ihenya, ũbataire gũcagũra thamaki ya ĩrĩa ĩhoreru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Thamaki cia mũthemba ũyũ itikoragwo na gĩthimi kĩa igũrũ kĩa omega-3 ikĩringithanio na thamaki cĩa njuuĩ-inĩ, no nĩ njega tondũ nĩ iheaga mwĩrĩ protĩini na indo ingĩ njega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calm lake fish are also typically more affordable and easier to find than wild river fish.
entries.translation: Ningĩ-rĩ, thamaki cia maria mahoreru itirĩ goro na nĩ cionekanaga na ũhũthũ gũkĩra thamaki cia njũũĩ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is low in cost and easy to care for, then you may want to choose a stock pond farm raised variety.
entries.translation: Angĩkorwo ũrenda thamaki ĩtarĩ na goro na thamaki ũngĩhota gũtungata na njĩra hũthũ, cagũra thamaki ya kũrĩithĩrio ndemu-inĩ ya mũgũnda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically raised in controlled environments and are fed a diet that is designed to promote growth.
entries.translation: Thamaki ici itungatagĩrwo handũ hararorwo wega na iheagwo irio cia gũteithĩrĩria ikũre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stock pond farm raised fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river or calm lake fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Thamaki cĩa kũrĩithĩrio ndemu-inĩ cia mũgũnda maita maingĩ itikoragwo na gĩthimi kĩa igũrũ kĩa omega-3 ĩkĩringithanio na thamaki cia njũũĩ-inĩ kana cia maria mahoreru, no nĩ iheaga mwĩrĩ protiini na indo ingĩ njega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the best type of fish for you will depend on your individual needs and preferences.
entries.translation: Mũico mũico-rĩ, mũthemba ũrĩa mwega mũno wa thamaki ũkũringana na mabataro makũ na maũndũ marĩa ũrenda we mwene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do some research to learn more about the different types of fish available and choose the one that is right for you.
entries.translation: Ĩka ũthuthuria nĩ getha ũmenye makĩria igũrũ rĩgĩĩ mĩthemba ngũrani ya thamaki na ũcagũre mũthemba ũrĩa ũkwagĩrĩire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unsolved mysteries have captured the public's imagination for centuries.
entries.translation: Kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka mĩingĩ, andũ nĩ makoretwo makĩgũcĩrĩrio nĩ iriga iria itamenyekanĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the disappearance of Amelia Earhart to the identity of Jack the Ripper, these cases have left us wondering what really happened.
entries.translation: Kuuma o rĩrĩa Amelia Earhart orire nginya rĩrĩa Jack the Ripper amenyekire, maũndũ maya nĩ matũmaga twĩyũrie nĩ kĩ giathire na mbere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While some of these mysteries may never be solved, they continue to fascinate us because they offer a glimpse into the unknown.
entries.translation: O na gũtuĩka maũndũ mamwe magũtũra marĩ kĩriga, magũthie na mbere na gũtũgũcĩrĩria nĩ tondũ nĩ matũmaga twĩcirie ũhoro wa maũndũ marĩa matoĩkaine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most famous unsolved mysteries is the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
entries.translation: Ũmwe wa maũndũ marĩ kĩriga mũno matoĩkaine nĩ kũra kwa Amelia Earhart.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earhart was an American aviator who became the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean.
entries.translation: Earhart arĩ mũtwari wa ndege wa Amerika na nĩwe warĩ mũtumia wa mbere kũmbũka igũrũ rĩa iria rĩa Atlantic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1937, she set out on an around-the-world flight with navigator Fred Noonan.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 1937, nĩathire rũgendo rwa gũtwikania thĩ na ndege marĩ na mũtwari ũngĩ wa ndege wetagwo Fred Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pair disappeared over the Pacific Ocean on July 2, 1937, and their fate remains unknown.
entries.translation: Andũ acio eerĩ morĩire Iria-inĩ rĩa Pacific kũrĩ mweri 2 Julaĩ, 1937, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũũĩ kũrĩa mathire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many theories about what happened to Earhart and Noonan.
entries.translation: Nĩ gwĩciragĩrio maũndũ maingĩ marĩa mangĩkorwo mahanĩkire kũrĩ Earhart na Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some believe that they crashed into the ocean, while others believe that they were captured by the Japanese.
entries.translation: Andũ amwe meciragia atĩ mathirĩire iria-inĩ, na arĩa angĩ nao meciragia atĩ andũ acio nĩ kũnyitwo manyitirwo mĩgwate nĩ andũ kuuma Japani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Still others believe that they deliberately disappeared in order to escape the public eye.
entries.translation: Na no kũrĩ angĩ metĩkĩtie atĩ andũ acio eerĩ morire makiendaga nĩ getha andũ matikanamenye kũrĩa marĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mystery of Earhart's disappearance has been the subject of books, articles, and documentaries.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũcio wa kĩriga gĩa kũũra wa Earhart nĩ ũkoretwo ũkĩandĩkwo mabuku-inĩ, icunjĩ-inĩ ona thenema-inĩ cia maũndũ marĩa mahanĩkaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, a team of researchers announced that they had found evidence that Earhart's plane crashed on a remote island in the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Kũrĩ mwaka wa 2017, gĩkundi kĩmwe kĩa athuthuria nĩ kĩarutire ndũmĩrĩri atĩ kĩarĩ na ũira atĩ ndege ya Earhart yaharaganĩire gĩcĩgĩrĩra-inĩ kĩmwe iria-inĩ rĩa Pacific.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are the largest species of arachnid in the world, with some individuals reaching lengths of over 12 inches.
entries.translation: Mabũbũĩ manene marĩa moikaine ta 'Giant wolf spiders' nĩmo manene mũno gũkũ thĩ mũhĩrĩga-inĩ wa mbũmbũĩ, na imwe ciacio ikoragwo na ũraihu wa makĩria ma inji 12.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are found in tropical rainforests around the world, and are known for their aggressive behavior and venomous bite.
entries.translation: Mbũmbũĩ icio cionekanaga mĩtitũ-inĩ ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo kũndũ kwĩna ũrugarĩ na mbura nyingĩ na cĩũĩkaine mũno nĩũndũ wa gũtharĩkĩra na kũrũma ĩgatiga thumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their fearsome reputation, giant wolf spiders are actually quite docile creatures.
entries.translation: O na gũtuĩka nĩ cia kũguoyohia, mbũmbũĩ icio nĩ nyamũ horeri mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are not aggressive towards humans unless they are provoked, and their venom is not typically fatal to humans.
entries.translation: Itingĩtharĩkĩra mũndũ itacogothetwo na thumu wacio ndũkoragwo na maumĩrĩra moru harĩ andũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, their bite can be quite painful, and can cause swelling, redness, and itching.
entries.translation: No ona kũrĩ o ũguo, kũrũmwo nĩ mbũmbũĩ icio no gũtũme mũndũ aigue ruo mũno, aimbe, atunĩhe na aigue mwĩthua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are excellent climbers, and can use their silk to create webs that can reach up to 30 feet in length.
entries.translation: Mbũmbũĩ icio ciũĩkaine ta 'Giant wolf spiders' nĩ njorua cia kũhaica na no ihũthĩre ndigi ciacio gũthondeka nyũmba cia mbũmbũĩ iria ingĩkinya nginya ũraihu wa fiti 30.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also very fast runners, and can move at speeds of up to 10 miles per hour.
entries.translation: Ningĩ, nĩ irĩ ihenya mũno, na no ithiĩ ihenya ta rĩa mairo 10 harĩ ithaa rĩmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Due to their size, speed, and climbing ability, giant wolf spiders are a popular choice for people who want to experience the thrill of riding a giant arachnid.
entries.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa mũigana wacio, ihenya na ũhoti wa kũhaica, mbũmbũĩ icio nene nĩ ithuragwo mũno nĩ andũ arĩa marenda gũkenera ihenya rĩa gũkuo kĩngaurũ kĩnene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to remember that these creatures are wild animals, and should be treated with respect.
entries.translation: Ona kũrĩ o ũguo, he bata kũririkana atĩ ici nĩ nyamũ cia gĩthaka, na nĩ ibataire kũheo gĩtĩo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are thinking about riding a giant wolf spider, it is important to do your research and make sure that you are properly prepared.
entries.translation: Angĩkorwo nĩ ũrathugunda gũkuo nĩ mbũmbũĩ nene, he bata wĩke ũthuthuria na ũtigĩrĩre atĩ nĩ weharĩria wega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure that you have the proper equipment, such as a harness and a leash.
entries.translation: Ningĩ nĩwagĩrĩire gũtigĩrĩra atĩ wĩna indo iria ciagĩrĩire, ta rũrigi na mũcibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are properly prepared, you can begin your journey by finding a suitable giant wolf spider.
entries.translation: Thutha wa kwĩharĩria wega, no wambĩrĩrie thabarĩ ya gwetha mbũmbũĩ ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found a spider, you can approach it slowly and gently.
entries.translation: Warĩkia kuona mbũmbũĩ, ũmĩkuhĩrĩrie kahora ũhoreire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the spider is comfortable with you, you can slowly climb onto its back.
entries.translation: Mbũmbũĩ yarĩkia gũkũmenyera na kũiganĩra, ũhaice mũgongo wayo kahora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are on the spider's back, you can hold on tightly and enjoy the ride.
entries.translation: Warĩkia gwĩka ũguo, wĩnyitĩrĩre wega na ũkenere gũkuo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The spider will use its silk to create a web that will support you as you ride.
entries.translation: Mbũmbũĩ ĩyo nĩ ikũhũthĩra rũrigi rwayo gũthondeka kanyũmba ka gũkũgirĩrĩria ũkuĩtwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Riding a giant wolf spider is an unforgettable experience.
entries.translation: Gũkuo nĩ mbũmbũĩ nene nĩ ũndũ wa gũcanjamũra mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a great way to experience the thrill of the wild, and to get up close and personal with one of the world's most fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: Nĩ njĩra njega mũno ya kwĩyonera magegania ma gĩthaka-inĩ na gũkuhanĩrĩria na ĩmwe ya nyamũ iria cia mwanya mũno gũkũ thĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I'm an actor and a furniture designer. I'm also passionate about flowers, especially those that bloom in the winter.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Ndĩ mũthaki wa mĩthako ya ngerekano na mũthondeki wa indo cia mbaũ. Ningĩ nĩnyendete mahua, mũno marĩa makũraga hĩndĩ ya heho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: What drew you to acting and furniture design?
entries.translation: Mũhooi wa ũhoro: Nĩ kĩ gĩatũmire wende gũthaka mĩthako ya ngerekano na gũthondeka indo cia mbaũ?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've always loved performing and creating things.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Ndũrĩte nyendete gũthaka mĩthako ya ngerekano na gũthondeka indo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acting allows me to express myself creatively, and furniture design allows me to use my creativity to make something beautiful and functional.
entries.translation: Gũthaka mĩthako ya ngerekano kũhotithagia kwĩyonania na njĩra ya mwanya na gũthondeka indo cia mbaũ kũhotithagia kũhũthĩra ũũgĩ wakwa gũthondeka kĩndũ gĩthaka kĩngĩhũthĩka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: What are some of the challenges you've faced as an actor and a furniture designer?
entries.translation: Mũhooi wa ũhoro: Nĩ moritũ marĩkũ ũkoretwo ũgĩcemania namo ta mũthaki wa ngerekano na mũthondeki wa indo cia mbaũ?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: One of the challenges I've faced as an actor is the lack of diversity in the industry.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: ũmwe wa moritũ marĩa ngoretwo ngĩcemania namo ta mũthaki wa ngerekano nĩ kwaga mĩaramano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've often been told that I'm not the right type for a role because of my race or ethnicity.
entries.translation: Kaingĩ nĩ njĩraguo atĩ ndĩagĩrĩirwo gũthaka handũ hana nĩ ũndũ wa rũruka rwakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a furniture designer, I've faced the challenge of breaking into a male-dominated industry.
entries.translation: Ta mũthondeki wa indo cia mbaũ-rĩ, nĩ njemanĩtie na ũritũ wa kũgeria gũtherema wĩra-inĩ ũrĩa ũrutagwo mũno nĩ athuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: How have you overcome these challenges?
entries.translation: Mũhooi wa ũhoro: ũhotete atĩa gũtoria moritũ maya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've overcome these challenges by working hard and never giving up.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Hotete kũmatoria na njĩra ya kwĩrutanĩria na kwaga gũkua ngoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Translation has many benefits, including increasing the relative value of content, improving accessibility, and opening up new markets.
entries.translation: Ũtaũrĩ nĩ ũrĩ ũguni mũingĩ, ta kuongerera bata wa mohoro, kuongerera ũhũthũ wa kũmakinyĩra na kũhingũra thoko njerũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When content is translated, it becomes accessible to a wider audience, which can lead to increased sales and profits.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa ũhoro wataũrwo, nĩ ũhotaga gũkinyĩra andũ aingĩ makĩria, ũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩteithĩrĩria kũgacĩria wendia na kũrehe uumithio mũnene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, translation can help to build relationships with customers in other countries and cultures.
entries.translation: Hamwe na ũguo, ũtaũri no ũteithie gũthondeka ndũgũ na agũri kuuma mabũrũri na ũndũire ngũrani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By displaying content in multiple languages, businesses can show that they are committed to reaching a global audience.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa biacara cionania mohoro na thiomi itiganĩte, nĩ cionanagia atĩ nĩ ciĩharĩirie gũkinyĩra andũ kuuma kũndũ guothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can help to build trust and credibility with potential customers.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũyũ no ũteithie gũthondeka wĩhokeku na gwĩtĩkĩrĩka nĩ agũri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some specific examples of how translation has benefited businesses: * A small business that sells handmade jewelry translated its website into Spanish, French, and German.
entries.translation: Ici nĩ imwe cia ngerekano ya ũrĩa ũtaũri ũgunĩte biacara: * Kambuni ĩmwe nini ya kwendia mathaga ma goro ĩtaũrĩte website yayo na rũthiomi rwa Kĩhispania, Kĩfaranja na Kĩnjĩrĩmani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, it saw a significant increase in sales from international customers * A large corporation that manufactures medical devices translated its product manuals into multiple languages.
entries.translation: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio kambuni ĩyo ĩkĩendia mũno kũrĩ agũri a mabũrũri ngũrani * Kambuni ĩmwe nene ĩria ithondekaga indo cia ũrigitani yataũrire mabuku mayo ma ũhũthĩri wa indo icio na thiomi itiganĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This helped to reach people in need who would not have otherwise been able to access the organization's resources.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũyũ nĩwateithirie gũkinyĩra andũ arĩa mabataire ũteithio, arĩa hihi matangĩahotete gũkinyĩra ũteithio wa rũhonge rũu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Translation is a powerful tool that can help businesses to grow and succeed.
entries.translation: Ũtaũri nĩ njĩra ya bata ya gũteithia biacara gũkũra na kũgacĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because we are all created in God's image, and God is the essence of rationality and order.
entries.translation: Gĩtũmi nĩ tondũ ithuothe tũmbĩtwo na mũhianĩre wa Ngai, na Ngai nĩwe kĩhumo kĩa ũũgĩ na watho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we live in accordance with our true nature, we are able to experience peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa twatũũra kũringana na ũrĩa tũhaana kũna, nĩ tũhotaga kũgĩa na thayũ na ũrũmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, when we allow our thoughts and actions to become chaotic and inconsistent, we experience inner conflict and turmoil.
entries.translation: No ningĩ-rĩ, rĩrĩa twarekereria meciria na mĩtugo iitũ ĩgĩe ngũĩ na yaage gũtwarana-rĩ, tũkoragwo na ngucanio na mĩtangĩko thĩĩnĩ witũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many ways to achieve internal consistency.
entries.translation: Nĩ kũrĩ njĩra nyingĩ cia kũhingia ũrũmwe wa na thĩĩnĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to live according to our values.
entries.translation: Njĩra ĩmwe nĩ gũtũũra kũringana na morutani marĩa mega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we know what is important to us and we make choices that are consistent with those values, we feel a sense of purpose and direction.
entries.translation: Tũngĩmenya maũndũ marĩa ma bata kũrĩ ithuĩ na tũtue matua marĩa maratwarana na maũndũ macio-rĩ, nĩ tũiguaga tũrĩ na muoroto na mwerekera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to achieve internal consistency is to be honest with ourselves about our strengths and weaknesses.
entries.translation: Njĩra ĩngĩ ya kũgĩa na ũrũmwe wa na thĩĩnĩ nĩ gũkorwo tũtakwĩhenia ithuĩ ene igũrũ rĩgiĩ hinya witũ na maũndũ marĩa matũgitagĩra hinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are aware of our true selves, we can make choices that are in alignment with our authentic nature.
entries.translation: Tũngĩhota kũmenya ũrĩa tũtarĩĩ kũna-rĩ, no tũhote gũtua matua maringaine na mũhianĩre witũ wa ma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, achieving internal consistency is not always easy.
entries.translation: Hatarĩ nganja ti ũndũ mũhũthũ kũgĩa na ũrũmwe wa na thĩĩnĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There will be times when we make mistakes or when we are faced with difficult choices.
entries.translation: Nĩ tũrĩhĩtagia rĩmwe na rĩmwe na rĩrĩa rĩngĩ tũgabatara gũtua matua maritũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if we are willing to strive for consistency, we will eventually find our way back to peace and harmony.
entries.translation: O na kũrĩ ũguo, tũngĩkorwo tũkĩenda gũthie na mbere na kũgeria-rĩ, mũico-inĩ no tũgacokerera thayũ na ũrũmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was the kind of headache that made you want to tear your hair out, or at least write a strongly worded letter to the makers of whatever it was that had given you the headache in the first place.
entries.translation: Nĩ mũtwe ũrĩa ũkũrĩyaga ũkaigua kũmunya njwĩrĩ, kana o na kwandĩka marua ma ciugo nditũ kũrĩ athondeki a kĩrĩa gĩtũmĩte ũrĩyo nĩ mũtwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In this case, the headache was the result of a particularly trying day at work.
entries.translation: Mũthenya ũcio, arĩyagwo nĩ mũtwe nũ ũndũ wa wĩra mũritũ ũrĩa atindĩte akĩruta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vimes had been investigating a series of robberies, and he was starting to feel like he was getting nowhere.
entries.translation: Vimes akoretwo agĩthuthuria ciĩko ngũrani cia ũici, na nĩ ambĩrĩirie kũigua ta gũtarĩ na umithio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was tired, he was frustrated, and he just wanted to go home and sleep for a week.
entries.translation: Aiguaga anogete na nĩakuĩte ngoro, na endaga o kũinũka agakome toro ta wa kiumia kĩmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was walking back to his office, Vimes passed a small stationery shop.
entries.translation: Arĩ njĩra-inĩ agĩcoka wabici-inĩ yake, Vimes akĩhĩtũkĩra nduka-inĩ nini ya indo cia kwandĩka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the window, he saw a sign that said "Best Letters in the City".
entries.translation: Akĩona karatathi kaandĩkĩtwo "Marũa marĩa mega mũno taũni-inĩ" ndirica-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vimes stopped and stared at the sign for a moment.
entries.translation: Vimes akĩrũgama akĩrora karathi kau kwa ihinda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He thought about his headache, and he thought about all the letters he had to write.
entries.translation: Agĩciria ũrĩa mũtwe ũramũria na marũa marĩa mothe abataire kwandĩka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He sighed and went into the shop.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The shop was full of all sorts of stationery supplies.
entries.translation: Nduka ĩyo yarĩ na indo cia mĩthemba yothe cia kwandĩka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were pens, pencils, paper, envelopes, stamps, and even a few typewriters.
entries.translation: Nĩ yarĩ na tũramu, maratathi, bahaca, mĩhũri, o na macini ciigana ũna cia kwandĩka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is true that there exist in this world situations that defy all explanation, events so strange and wondrous that they seem to be the stuff of dreams or nightmares.
entries.translation: Nĩ ma atĩ thĩinĩ wa thĩ ĩno kũrĩ maũndũ matangĩtaarĩrio, maũndũ ma kĩriga na ma kũgegania mũno ũũ atĩ monekaga ta arĩ iroto kana iroto njũru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Such is the case with the story I am about to tell you, a tale of supernatural forces and the strange events that unfolded when they were unleashed upon the world.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũmwe ta ũcio nĩ karũgano gaka ndĩrenda gũkũganĩra, rũgano rwa mahinya matarĩ ma ndũire na maũndũ ma kũgegania marĩa mekĩkire rĩrĩa monekire rĩa mbere gũkũ thĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It all began one night, when a group of friends were gathered together for a party.
entries.translation: Maũndũ macio maambĩrĩirie ũtukũ ũmwe, rĩrĩa gĩkundi kĩa arata kĩagomanĩte hamwe nĩũndũ wa iruga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were drinking and laughing, enjoying each other's company, when suddenly the lights went out.
entries.translation: Manyuaga magĩthekaga, magĩkenanagĩra, rĩrĩa matawa mahorire o rĩmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The room was plunged into darkness, and the only sound was the sound of their own breathing.
entries.translation: Nyũmba ng'ima ĩkĩiyũra nduma, na mũgambo ũrĩa waiguĩkaga no wa mĩhũmũ yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, in the darkness, they saw it: a strange, glowing light.
entries.translation: Thutha-inĩ marĩ nduma-inĩ makĩona ũtheri wa magegania.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It seemed to be coming from nowhere, and it was growing brighter and brighter.
entries.translation: Ndwamenyekaga kũrĩa ũrauma no wathiaga ũkĩongererekaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The friends were terrified, but they were also curious.
entries.translation: Arata acio makĩmaka, no nĩ mendaga gũtaũkwo nĩ ũndũ ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They wanted to know what this light was, and where it was coming from.
entries.translation: Nĩ mendaga kũmenya ũtheri ũcio warĩ wa kĩ na woimite kũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they got closer, they could see that it was coming from a small, glowing sphere.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa makuhĩrĩirie, makiona atĩ ũtheri ũcio waumaga kamũbira-inĩ kanini karakenga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sphere was hovering in the air, and it was surrounded by a faint aura.
entries.translation: Kamũbira kau kereraga rĩera-inĩ na gathiũrũrũkiĩirio nĩ ũtheri mũnini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Dude, I'm so heartbroken right now. My girlfriend of 2 years just broke up with me."
entries.translation: "Reke ngwĩre, ndĩna ihooru mũno. Mũirĩtu ũrĩa ndĩrari ndũgũ nake mĩaka ĩĩrĩ nĩarandigire."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I don't know. She just said she wasn't feeling it anymore.
entries.translation: "Ndiũĩ. Araugire ndaraigua akĩenda ndũgũ iitũ rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm sorry, man.I know how you feel. Heartbreak sucks."
entries.translation: "Nĩ ndaigua ũũru mũno. Nĩnjũĩ ũrĩa ũraigua. Mũndũ atigĩtwo aiguaga ũũru mũno."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It does. I don't know what to do."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cry it out if you need to.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then, when you're ready, start to move on.
entries.translation: Thutha ũcio, wahona ngoro, ũthie na mbere na gwetha ndũgũ ĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are plenty of other fish in the sea."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know. But I don't know if I'm ready to date again yet."
entries.translation: "Nĩnjũĩ. No ndiĩ kana nĩndĩharĩirie kũingĩra ndũgũ-inĩ ĩngĩ ya kĩwendo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's okay. You don't have to be ready right away. Just take your time and heal."
entries.translation: "ũguo nĩ wega. To mũhaka ũkorwo wĩharĩirie o rĩu. Wĩhe kahinda ga kũhonia ngoro."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
