entries.english: A: Do you think the dowry system is a good thing?
entries.translation: A: Hihi nĩ wonaga kũracia kũrĩ ũndũ mwega?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I think it's a form of discrimination against women.
entries.translation: Ngwĩciria nĩ njĩra ya gũthũtukania atumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It puts an unfair financial burden on the bride's family, and it can lead to women being treated as commodities.
entries.translation: Nĩ mũrigo mũritũ wa kĩmbeca kũrĩ bamĩrĩ ya mũhiki, na no gũtũme atumia monagwo ta marĩ indo cia biacara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: But some people say that the dowry system is a way to protect women.
entries.translation: A: No gũkĩrĩ andũ moigaga atĩ kũracia nĩ njĩra ya kũgĩtĩra atumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I don't think that's true.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, I think it can put women in danger.
entries.translation: Ũhoro wa ma nĩ atĩ, no gũtũme atumia makorũo ũgwati-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If a woman's family can't afford to pay a dowry, she may be less likely to be able to find a husband.
entries.translation: Bamĩrĩ ya mũtumia ĩngĩkorwo ĩtarĩ na ũhoti wa kũracia, no ũkorwo ũtarĩ ũndũ mũhũthũ harĩ mũtumia ũcio kuona mũthuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if she does get married, she may be more likely to be abused or mistreated by her husband.
entries.translation: Na angĩhika, no gũkorwo na ũhotekeku mũnene wa kũhinyĩrĩrio nĩ mũthuri wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: So what do you think we should do about the dowry system?
entries.translation: A: Hihi ũreciria tũbataire gwĩka atĩa ũndũ-inĩ wĩgiĩ kũracia?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I think we should work to abolish it.
entries.translation: B: Ngwĩciria twagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũnina ũndũ ũcio biũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We should educate people about the harmful effects of the dowry system, and we should support laws that make it illegal to demand or accept a dowry.
entries.translation: Twagĩrĩirũo kũruta andũ ũhoro wĩgiĩ moimĩrĩro moru ma kũracia, na twagĩrĩirũo kũnyita mbaru mawatho marĩa magiragia mũndũ gũĩtia kana kwamũkĩra rũracio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I agree. I think the dowry system is a relic of a bygone era.
entries.translation: A: O na niĩ nĩ ndetĩkanirie nawe. Ngwĩciria mũtaratara wa kũracia nĩ wa tene mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have been living with type 1 diabetes for over 20 years.
entries.translation: Kwa ihinda rĩa makĩria ma mĩaka 20, nĩ ngoretwo ndĩ na mũrimũ wa cukari wa mũthemba wa 1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was diagnosed when I was just 10 years old, and it has been a lifelong journey.
entries.translation: Ndarĩ na mĩaka ikũmi rĩrĩa ndaamenyire atĩ ndĩ na mũrimũ ũcio, na ũndũ ũcio ũkoretwo ũrĩ mũritũ ũtũũro-inĩ wakwa wothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There have been many challenges along the way, but I have also learned a lot about myself and what it means to be a strong, resilient person.
entries.translation: Nĩ ngoretwo na moritũ maingĩ ũtũũro-inĩ wakwa, no nĩ ndĩĩrutĩte maũndũ maingĩ megiĩ niĩ mwene na ũrĩa mũndũ ũrĩ na hinya na ũhoti wa kũhiũrania na moritũ akoragwo atariĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest challenges I have faced is managing my blood sugar levels.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũmwe ũria ũkoretwo ũrĩ mũritũ mũno nĩ gũthingata ithimi cia cukari thakame-inĩ yakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Diabetes is a condition that affects the way your body turns food into energy.
entries.translation: Mũrimũ wa cukari nĩ thĩna ũrĩa ũcenjagia ũrĩa mwĩrĩ ũgarũraga irio ituĩke hinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you eat, your body breaks down the carbohydrates in your food into glucose, which is then absorbed into your bloodstream.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa warĩa irio, mwĩrĩ waku ũgarũraga kabohaidrĩti iria irĩ irio-inĩ ituĩke glukosi, iria icokaga igatonya thakame-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that helps glucose get from your blood into your cells.
entries.translation: Rwariũngũ rwaku rũrutaga insulin, homoni ĩrĩa ĩteithagia glukosi yume thakame-inĩ yaku ĩtonye kũrĩ tũhengereta twa mwĩrĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In people with type 1 diabetes, the pancreas doesn't make enough insulin, or it doesn't make any at all.
entries.translation: Kũrĩ andũ arĩa makoragwo na mũrimũ wa cukari mũthemba wa 1, rwariũngũ rũtithondekaga insulin ya kũigana, kana rũkaga gũthondeka o na hanini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that people with type 1 diabetes have to take insulin injections to help their bodies use glucose for energy.
entries.translation: Ũguo nĩ kuuga atĩ andũ arĩa marĩ na mũrimũ wa cukari wa mũthemba wa 1 no mũhaka mathecwo cindano cia insulin nĩguo mĩĩrĩ yao ĩhũthĩre glucose kũruta hinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Managing my blood sugar levels can be a tricky business.
entries.translation: Gũthingata gĩthimi gĩa cukari wa thakame yakwa no gũkorwo kũrĩ wĩra mũritũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a lot of factors that can affect my blood sugar, including what I eat, how much I exercise, and how much stress I am under.
entries.translation: Maũndũ ngũrani no macenjie gĩthimi kĩa cukari wa thakame yakwa. Maũndũ macio nĩ hamwe na kĩrĩa ndĩrarĩa, ũrĩa ndĩrarutithia mwĩrĩ wĩra, na gĩthimi kĩa mĩtangĩko ĩrĩa ndĩ nayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.
entries.translation: No mũhaka njikare ngĩroraga ithimi cia cukari ũrĩa ũrĩ thakame-inĩ yakwa na njenjie ndawa cia insulin rĩrĩa gwabatarania.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors dance on your tongue, creating a symphony of delight.
entries.translation: Mĩcamo ĩtukanaga wega mũno kanua-inĩ gaku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pineapple is sweet and tart, the apple is crisp and juicy, the stone fruit is juicy and flavorful, and the pear is sweet and refreshing.
entries.translation: Inanathi nĩ rĩrĩ mũrĩo na ũgagatu mũnini, itunda ria ĩpũ nĩ rĩũmũ hanini na nũ rĩrĩ tũmaai tũthaka, ngario nĩ ĩrĩ mũcamo wa gũcanjamũra, na ngando o na yo nĩ ĩrĩ mũcamo wa mwanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors are perfectly balanced, and each one complements the others.
entries.translation: Mĩcamo ĩyo ĩkoragwo na ũigananu na itunda rĩmwe rĩihũragĩrĩria mũcamo wa rĩrĩa rĩngĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can enjoy this delicious fruit salad on its own, or as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.
entries.translation: No ũkenere matunda macio marĩ moiki, kana ũmahũthĩre hamwe na yogurt kana ice cream.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a great addition to a summer picnic or potluck.
entries.translation: Nĩngĩ nĩ mega mũno ma gũkuua rĩrĩa ũrathiĩ kũgomana na andũ hĩndĩ ya riũa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how you enjoy it, you are sure to love this fruit salad.
entries.translation: Gũtiramakania ũrĩa ũkũmarĩa, hatarĩ nganja nĩ ũgũkenera matunda maya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?
entries.translation: A: Ĩĩ hihi nĩũĩ atĩ gũthũkangio kwa mĩtitũ nĩ ũndũ ũmwe ũrĩa ũcũngagĩrĩra ũgarũrũku wa rĩera?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.
entries.translation: A: Rĩrĩa twatema mĩtĩ, to mĩtĩ tu tũthũkagia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.
entries.translation: Tũkoragwo tũgĩthũkia nginya mĩciĩ ya nyamũ na mĩmera mĩingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.
entries.translation: Na rĩrĩa tũrathũkia mĩciĩ ĩyo, tũrathũkia nginya ũguni ũrĩa twonaga kuumana nayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.
entries.translation: A: Kwa ngerekano, mĩtĩ nĩ ĩteithagia gũthondeka rĩera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.
entries.translation: Ĩteithagia kũgucia kaboni dayoksaidi kuuma rĩera-inĩ ĩgacoka ĩkarehe oksijeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.
entries.translation: Ningĩ nĩ ĩteithagia kũrigĩrĩria kũaraha na tĩĩri ndũgakuuo nĩ maaĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they provide food and shelter for animals.
entries.translation: Na o ho nĩ ũheaga nyamũ irio na ũikaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.
entries.translation: B: Kwoguo gũthũkio kwa mĩtĩ nĩ kũrehaga moimĩrĩra moru maingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.
entries.translation: Na thĩna ũcio nĩ ũrathiĩ na mbere kũingĩha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.
entries.translation: O mwaka, nĩ tũthũkagia mamirioni ma ĩka cia miĩtitũ nĩ ũndũ wa gũtemanga mĩtĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.
entries.translation: Na tũngĩaga gwĩka ũndũ wa kũgirĩrĩria ũndũ ũcio, moimĩrĩra mangĩkorũo marĩ moru mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: What can we do to stop it?
entries.translation: B: Nĩ atĩa tũngĩka nĩ getha tũrigĩrĩrie?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: There are a number of things we can do.
entries.translation: A: Nĩ harĩ maũndũ maigana ũna tũngĩka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can reduce our demand for wood products.
entries.translation: No tũnyihanyihie mabataro maitũ ma indo cia mbaũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to attend a school that offered a wide range of AP courses and extracurricular activities, which gave me the opportunity to explore my interests and learn about different career paths.
entries.translation: Nĩ ndaagĩire na mweke wa gũthiĩ cukuru ĩrĩa yarĩ na mathomo maingĩ ma AP na maũndũ mangĩ, marĩa maheire mweke wa gũthuthuria maũndũ marĩa nyendete na kwĩruta ũhoro wĩgiĩ mawĩra matiganĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũmwe wa bata mũno ndeerutire cukuru ya sekondarĩ warĩ ũrĩa ingĩĩciria na njĩra ya ũritũ na kũniina mathĩna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
entries.translation: Mathomo makwa ma Gĩthũngũ na ma Mathabu ma AP nĩ mandutire ũrĩa ingĩthuthuria mĩandiko na ũhoro, na mathomo makwa ma sayansi makĩnduta ũrĩa ingĩthondeka maũndũ na ndĩmagerie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
entries.translation: Ũmenyeru ũcio nĩ ũndeithĩtie mũno cukuru-inĩ wa Yunivasĩtĩ na wĩra-inĩ wakwa wa gũthondeka programu cia kompiuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũngĩ wa bata nderutire cukuru ya sekondarĩ nĩ ũrĩa ingĩrutithania wĩra na andũ arĩa angĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
entries.translation: Ũmenyeru ũcio nĩ ũkoretwo ũrĩ wa bata mũno wĩra-inĩ wakwa, kũrĩa kaingĩ bataraga kũnyitanĩra na andũ angĩ gwetha kĩhonia kũa maũndũ maritũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
entries.translation: Ũndũ wa kũrigĩrĩria nĩ atĩ, maũndũ marĩa ndeerutire cukuru ya sekondarĩ nĩ maandeithirie gũkũria mwerekera mwega wa kũruta wĩra na kwĩrutanĩria mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
entries.translation: Mathomo mau maritũ ndathomire nĩmandutire bata wa kũgĩa na kĩyo na ũkirĩrĩria, na maũndũ macio mangĩ kando na mathomo makĩndeithia kũmenya bata wa kwĩrutĩra na kũnyitanĩra na andũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
entries.translation: Maũndũ maya nĩ mandeithitie kũgacĩra cukuru-inĩ wa yunivasiti na wĩra-inĩ wakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
entries.translation: Nĩ ngenaga mũno nĩ ũndũ wa mweke ũrĩa ndaarĩ naguo wa gũthiĩ cukuru ya sekondarĩ ĩrĩa yandutire maũndũ ma bata mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
entries.translation: Nĩ njĩtĩkĩtie atĩ ũũgĩ na ũmenyo ũrĩa ndaagĩire naguo cukuru ya sekondarĩ nĩ ũndeithĩtie gũtuĩka mũrutwo mwega wa yunivasĩtĩ na mũtaaramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is a craft that involves making objects out of clay.
entries.translation: Kũũmba indo cĩa rĩũmba nĩ gũthondeka indo na rĩũmba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is often used for utilitarian purposes, such as storing food or water, but it can also be used for decorative purposes.
entries.translation: Kaingĩ indo cia rĩũmba ihũthagĩrũo kũruta wĩra, ta kũiga irio kana maaĩ, no ningĩ no ihũthĩrũo kũgemia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of making pottery begins with gathering clay.
entries.translation: Mũtaratara wa gũthondeka indo cia rĩũmba wambagĩrĩria na gũcokanĩrĩria rĩũmba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Clay is a natural material that is found in the ground.
entries.translation: Rĩũmba nĩ kĩndũ kĩa ndũire kĩriĩa kĩonekanaga thĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay has been gathered, it is mixed with water and kneaded until it is soft and pliable.
entries.translation: Rĩũmba rĩarĩkia gũcokanĩrĩrio, rĩtukanagio na maaĩ na rĩkanyitithanio nginya rĩgatuĩka rĩororo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The potter then uses a variety of tools to shape the clay into the desired form.
entries.translation: Mũũmbĩ agacoka akahũthĩra indo itiganĩte gũthondeka rĩũmba rĩu ũrĩa akwenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay is shaped, it is dried and fired in a kiln.
entries.translation: Thutha wa gũthondeka rĩũmba rĩu, nĩ rĩũmithagio na rĩgacinwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.
entries.translation: Mbura ya kĩhuhũkanio nĩ yonekaga kũndũ kũingĩ thĩinĩ wa thĩ, na no ĩhutie mũno ũtũũro witũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.
entries.translation: No ĩrehe maĩ marĩa mabataranagia mũno kũndũ kũũmũ, no ningĩ no itũme kũgĩe na mĩiyũro, ithingithia, na hathara ingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.
entries.translation: Mbura ya kĩhuhũkanio yonekanaga rĩrĩa rĩera rĩhiũhĩte rĩambata igũrũ, ũndũ ũrĩa ũtũmaga matata ma maaĩ matuĩke matu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.
entries.translation: Matata macio ma maaĩ matu-inĩ mangĩkorwo marĩ maritũ mũno-rĩ, nĩ mambagĩrĩria kuura ta mbura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.
entries.translation: Gĩthimi kĩa maaĩ marĩa magũaga hĩndĩ ya mbura ya kĩhuhũkanio mathĩmagwo na inji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.
entries.translation: Kĩhuhũkanio kĩnini no kĩrehe mbura inji cigana ũna tu, no kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene no kĩrehe mbura makĩria ma futi ĩmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.
entries.translation: Mbura ya kĩhuhũkanio no ĩhutie ũtũũro witũ na njĩra ĩtiganĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.
entries.translation: No ĩthambie gĩko na mahiga, ũndũ ũrĩa ũtũmaga barabara na njĩra itikagereke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also cause power outages and flooding.
entries.translation: Nĩngĩ no ĩtũme thitima ĩhore kana kũgie na mũiyũro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.
entries.translation: Mũiyũro no ũrehe ũgwati mũnene mũno, tondũ no ũthererie andũ hamwe na indo ciao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.
entries.translation: O na kũrĩ na mogwati macio, mbura ya kĩhuhũkanio no ĩkorwo na ũguni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.
entries.translation: No ĩteithie gũthondeka tĩĩri na kũhe mĩmera maaĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.
entries.translation: Mbura ya kĩhuhũkanio no ĩkorũo ĩrĩ kĩndũ gĩa gwĩkenia, tondũ andũ nĩ makenagĩra kwĩrorera mbura na gũthikĩrĩria marurumĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eyes are complex organs that allow us to see.
entries.translation: Maitho nĩ ciĩga cia magegania iria itũteithagia kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are located in the front of the head and are protected by the eyelids.
entries.translation: Makoragwo mwena wa mbere wa mũtwe na nĩ mahumbĩrĩtwo nĩ imone.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each eye is made up of three layers: the sclera, the choroid, and the retina.
entries.translation: Riitho o rĩothe rĩkoragwo na icunjĩ ithatũ: sclera, choroid, na retina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sclera is the white part of the eye, the choroid is the dark layer behind the sclera, and the retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Sclera nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩrĩa kĩerũ kĩa riitho, choroid nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩrĩa kĩiru thutha wa sclera, na retina nĩ gĩcunjĩ gĩa thutha kĩa riitho kĩrĩa kĩiguaga ũtheri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina contains millions of light-sensitive cells called rods and cones.
entries.translation: Retina ĩkoragwo na tũhengereta tũingĩ mũno tũrĩa twĩtagwo 'rods' na 'cones'.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rods are responsible for night vision, while cones are responsible for color vision.
entries.translation: Rods iteithagĩrĩria kuona wega ũtukũ, nacio cones iteithagĩrĩria kuona marangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When light hits the retina, it is converted into electrical signals that are sent to the brain via the optic nerve.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa ũtheri wakinyĩra retina, ũgarũragwo ũgatuĩka imenyithia cia thitima iria itũmagwo kũrĩ tombo kũhĩtũkĩra mũkiha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My family has always kept animals.
entries.translation: Bamĩrĩ iitũ ĩkoretwo ĩkĩiga nyamũ kuuma tene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a child, we had a dog, a cat, and a few fish.
entries.translation: Rĩrĩa ndarĩ mwana, nĩ twarĩ na ngui, nyau na thamaki ciigana ũna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I got older, we added a few more animals to the mix, including a rabbit, a guinea pig, and a hamster.
entries.translation: Ndakũrakũra, nĩ tuongereire nyamũ ingĩ, ta thungura, ngũrũwe ya ngine, na mbũkũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved taking care of all of our animals and learning about their different needs.
entries.translation: Nĩ ndakenagĩra mũno kũrũmbũiya nyamũ citũ ciothe na kwĩruta mabataro macio matiganĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite animals that we ever kept was a rabbit named Cocoa.
entries.translation: Nyamũ ĩmwe ĩrĩa ndendete mũno twakoragwo nayo nĩ thungura yetagwo Cocoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cocoa was a brown and white Holland Lop rabbit.
entries.translation: Cocoa yarĩ thungura ya Holland Lop ya rangi mwerũ na wa mburaũni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was the sweetest animal I've ever met and she loved to be cuddled.
entries.translation: Arĩ nyamũ ĩrĩa arĩ njega mũno na nĩyendete kũnyitwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was also very smart and could learn tricks like sit, stay, and come.
entries.translation: Ningĩ arĩ mũgĩ mũno na nĩahotaga kũmenya maũndũ ta gũikara thĩ, kũrũgama na gũũka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was playing with Cocoa in the backyard when I noticed that she was chewing on something.
entries.translation: Mũthenya ũmwe-rĩ, ndathakaga na Cocoa mũgũnda-inĩ na ngĩona akĩrĩa kĩndũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I went over to investigate and saw that she was chewing on a piece of fiber from one of our clothes.
entries.translation: Ngĩkuhĩrĩria nĩ getha nyone nĩ kĩ ararĩa na ngĩona atanukaga karũrigi ka ĩmwe ya nguo ciitũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took the fiber away from her and showed it to my mom.
entries.translation: Ngĩmũtunya karũrigi kau na ngĩonia mami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mom explained that rabbits need to eat fiber in order to digest their food properly.
entries.translation: Mami akĩndarĩria atĩ thungura nĩ ĩbataraga irio cia ndigi nĩ getha ĩhote gũthĩa irio wega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that we should give Cocoa some hay to eat, which is a good source of fiber.
entries.translation: Akiuga atĩ nĩ tũbataire kũhe Cocoa nyeki ya kũrĩa, tondũ nĩrĩ ndigi iria ĩbatarainie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gave Cocoa some hay and she loved it!
entries.translation: Ngĩhe Cocoa nyeki na agĩkena mũno!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: An earthquake is a sudden and violent shaking of the Earth's crust that can cause great damage.
entries.translation: Gĩthingithia nĩ rĩrĩa thĩ ĩrainaina na hinya o rĩmwe na no kĩrehe hathara nene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these plates move past or collide with each other, they can cause the Earth's crust to break and produce seismic waves.
entries.translation: Hĩndĩ ĩria icunjĩ icio irahĩtũkana kana ikagũthana, no itũme ũthiũ wa thĩ uunĩke na ũrute makũmbĩ ma gĩthingithia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These waves travel through the Earth and can cause the ground to shake.
entries.translation: Makũmbĩ macio mathiagĩra kũu Thĩ na no matũme thĩ ĩinaine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The magnitude of an earthquake is measured on the Richter scale, which ranges from 0 to 9.
entries.translation: Ũritũ wa gĩthingithia ũthimagwo na gĩthimi kĩa Richter, kuuma 0 nginya 9.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The higher the magnitude, the more powerful the earthquake.
entries.translation: O ũrĩa gĩthingithia kĩrĩ kĩnene, noguo gĩkoragwo na ũritũ mũnene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can cause damage in a variety of ways, including ground shaking, landslides, tsunamis, building collapses, fires, and loss of life.
entries.translation: Thĩna ũrĩa ũrehagwo nĩ ithingithia no ũkorũo ũrĩ wa mĩthemba mĩingĩ, ta gũthingitha kwa thĩ, gũtigithũkanio kwa tĩĩri, tsunami, nyũmba kũgũa, mwaki, na andũ gũkua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can also trigger other hazards, such as avalanches.
entries.translation: Ningĩ ithingithia no itũme kũgĩe na mogwati mangĩ, ta kũharũrũka kwa mbarafu irĩma-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The damage caused by an earthquake depends on a number of factors, including the magnitude of the earthquake, the distance from the epicenter, the type of soil, and the construction of buildings.
entries.translation: Gĩthingithia gĩthũkangagia indo kũringana na maũndũ ngũrani, ta ũritũ wa gĩthingithia, ũraihu wa harĩa gĩthingithia kĩrĩ kuuma gatagatĩ ga thĩ, mũthemba wa tĩĩri, na ũriĩa nyũmba ciakĩtwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have no idea how the real world works, and you think that everything should be handed to you on a silver platter.
entries.translation: Mũtiũĩ ũrĩa maũndũ thĩ ĩno makoragwo mahaana, na mwĩciragia atĩ mũbataire kũnengerwo indo ciothe iria mũrenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're always complaining about something, and you never seem to be happy with anything.
entries.translation: Mũtũraga mũng'ong'oiraga nĩ ũndũ mũna, na gũtirĩ hĩndĩ mũkoragwo mũkenete.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're a bunch of entitled brats, and I'm sick of it.
entries.translation: Mũrĩ andũ atũrĩku mũno na nĩnogete nĩ ũndũ ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world doesn't owe you anything.
entries.translation: Ĩno thĩ ndĩrĩ na thirĩ wanyu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have to work hard to get what you want.
entries.translation: No mũhaka mũrute wĩra na kĩyo nĩ getha muone kĩrĩa mũkwenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no such thing as a free lunch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want something, you have to go out and earn it.
entries.translation: Ũngĩenda kĩndũ, no mũhaka ũthiĩ ũgĩcarie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not going to get you anywhere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a problem, then solve it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't just sit around and cry about it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Ĩkagai maũndũ kũringana na ũkũrũ wanyu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's time to start acting like adults.
entries.translation: Ihinda nĩ ikinyu rĩa kwambĩrĩria gwĩka maũndũ ta andũ agima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm tired of dealing with your childish behavior.
entries.translation: Nĩ nonegetio nĩ mĩtugo yanyu ya wana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't start acting like adults, then I'm going to have to cut you out of my life.
entries.translation: Mwaga kwambĩrĩria gwĩka maũndũ ta andũ agima, nĩngũmweheria mũtũũrĩre-inĩ wakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't have time for your nonsense.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grow up and start acting like adults, or I'm out of here.
entries.translation: Gimarai na mwambĩrĩrie gwĩka maũndũ ta andũ agima, kana ndĩyeherie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was recently cleaning out my attic when I came across a box of old recipes that had been passed down from my grandmother.
entries.translation: Ica ikuhĩ ndĩrathambagia kanyũmba gakwa ka igũrũ na ndĩracemania na kathandũkũ kena mabuku makũrũ ma kũruga marĩa matigĩtwo nĩ cucu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of them were quite old, dating back to the early 1900s.
entries.translation: Mamwe mamo marĩ ma tene mũno, o kuuma karine-inĩ ya 19.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New Study Finds That Breast Cancer Screenings Can Lead to False Positives
entries.translation: Ũthuthuria Mwerũ Wonanĩtie atĩ Gũthuthuria Mũrimũ wa Kansa ya Nyondo no Kũrehe Maumĩrĩra Matarĩ ma Ma
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A new study published in the journal JAMA Internal Medicine has found that breast cancer screenings can lead to false positives.
entries.translation: Ũthuthuria mwerũ ũcabĩtwo thĩinĩ wa ngathĩti ya JAMA Internal Medicine wonanĩtie atĩ gũthuthuria kansa ya nyondo no kũrehe moimĩrĩra matarĩ ma ma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A false positive result is when a mammogram shows that a woman has breast cancer, when she actually does not.
entries.translation: Moimĩrĩra matarĩ ma ma nĩ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũthuthuria wa macini wonania atĩ mũtumia ena kansa ya nyondo, no ũũma nĩ atĩ ndarĩ nayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to unnecessary anxiety and stress, as well as unnecessary medical procedures, such as biopsies.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũcio no ũtũme mũndũ agĩe na mĩtangĩko na meciria maritũ, o hamwe na kũhũthĩra njĩra cia ũrigitani itarĩ cia bata, ta kũrutwo tũnyama twa mwĩrĩ nĩ getha tũthimwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study found that the rate of false positives was higher among women who were younger, had dense breasts, and had a family history of breast cancer.
entries.translation: Ũthuthuria ũcio wonanirie atĩ moimĩrĩra matarĩ ma ma monekanaga mũno kũrĩ atumia ethĩ, arĩa mena gĩthũrĩ kĩnene, na arĩa mena histori ya kansa ya nyondo bamĩrĩ-inĩ ciao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The researchers say that these findings are important because they highlight the need for women to understand the risks and benefits of breast cancer screening before they decide whether or not to undergo a mammogram.
entries.translation: Athuthuria acio maroiga atĩ moimĩrĩra macio nĩ ma bata tondũ monanagia bata wa atumia kũmenya mogwatĩ na ũguni wa gũthuthurio kana mena kansa ya nyondo mbere ya gũtua matua ma gũthimwo na macini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the use of sound waves, known as ultrasound, to screen for breast cancer can help to reduce the number of false positives.
entries.translation: Ningĩ ũthuthuria ũcio nĩ wonanirie atĩ ũhũthĩri wa makũmbĩ ma mĩgambo, marĩa moĩkaine ta ultrasound, gũthuthuria kansa ya nyondo no ũteithie kũnyihanyihia moimĩrĩra matarĩ ma ma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultrasound is a safe and non-invasive imaging technique that can be used to identify abnormalities in the breast.
entries.translation: Ultrasound nĩ njĩra njega ya gũthondeka mbica ĩtarĩ na ũgwati na no ĩhũthĩrũo gũkũũrana mathĩna marĩa marĩ thĩinĩ wa nyondo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A typical day for a person in Nigeria might start with a cup of tea or coffee and a breakfast of bread, eggs, and plantains.
entries.translation: Mũthenya wa mũndũ ũrĩ Nĩgeria no wambĩrĩrie na gĩkombe gĩa cai kana kahũa na irio cia mũgate, matumbĩ na marigũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The workday typically starts around 8am and ends around 5pm, with a lunch break in the middle of the day.
entries.translation: Mũthenya wa kawaida wambagĩrĩria ta thaa igĩrĩ cia rũcini na ũgathira thaa ikũmi na imwe cia hwa-inĩ, na andũ nĩ marĩaga irio cia mũthenya hau gatagatĩ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After work, people might relax at home with their families, go out to dinner, or attend a cultural event.
entries.translation: Thutha wa wĩra, andũ no mathiĩ kũhorera mũciĩ na bamĩrĩ ciao, mathiĩ makarĩe irio cia hwa-inĩ nja, kana mathiĩ magatukane na andũ angĩ magongona-inĩ ma ũndũire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The evening is often spent socializing with friends and family.
entries.translation: Mahinda ma hwaĩ-inĩ kaingĩ mahũthagĩrũo kũnyitanĩra na arata na andũ a bamĩrĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The daily routine of a Nigerian can vary depending on their location and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Maũndũ marĩa mekagwo o mũthenya nĩ mũndũ wĩ Nigeria no makorwo marĩ ngũrani kũringana na kũrĩa mũndũ arĩ na mũtũũrĩre wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, people may wake up earlier to tend to their farms or livestock.
entries.translation: Icaginĩ-rĩ, andũ no mokĩre tene hanini nĩ getha magatungate mĩgũnda kana mahiũ mao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In urban areas, people may have more time for leisure activities.
entries.translation: Nakuo mataũni-inĩ andũ no makorwo na mahinda maingĩ ma gwĩka maũndũ ma gwĩkenia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some aspects of daily life are common across Nigeria, such as the importance of family and community.
entries.translation: O na kũrĩ ũguo, maũndũ mamwe ma ũtũũro wa o mũthenya nĩ mahanaine bũrũri-inĩ wothe wa Nigeria, ta bata wa bamĩrĩ na andũ a itũũra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nigeria is a diverse country with a rich culture, and the daily lives of its people reflect this diversity.
entries.translation: Bũrũri wa Nigeria nĩ ũkoragwo na andũ a mĩthemba mĩingĩ, na mũtũũrĩre wa o mũthenya wa andũ a bũrũri ũcio nĩ kĩonereria kĩiganu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the bustling cities of Lagos and Abuja to the more rural areas of the country, there is no one-size-fits-all description of what a typical day in Nigeria is like.
entries.translation: Kuuma taũni-inĩ cia Lagos na Abuja nginya icagi-inĩ cia Nigeria, gũtirĩ ũndũ ũmwe ũngĩhota gũtaarĩria ũrĩa mũthenya wa kawainda ũhaana bũrũri-inĩ ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But one thing is for sure: no matter where you are in Nigeria, you will find people who are warm, welcoming, and eager to share their culture with you.
entries.translation: No ũndũ ũmwe ũrĩa tũngĩkorũo na ma naguo nĩ atĩ: o kũrĩa guothe ũrĩ bũrũri-inĩ wa Nigeria, nĩ ũkuona andũ marĩ na ũrata, ũtugi, na makoragwo na wendi mũnene wa gũkũonia ũhoro wa ũndũire wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nyasaland African Congress (NAC) was founded in 1944 by Dr. Hastings Kamuzu Banda and other Malawian nationalists.
entries.translation: Kĩama kĩa Nyasaland African Congress (NAC) kĩambĩrĩirio mwaka wa 1944 nĩ Ndagitari Hastings Kamuzu Banda na andũ angĩ a bũrũri wa Malawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The NAC was the first political party in Malawi to advocate for African independence from British colonial rule.
entries.translation: NAC nĩyo yarĩ gĩkundi kĩa mbere kĩa ũteti bũrũri-inĩ wa Malawi gĩa kũrũĩrĩra wĩyathi wa Abirika kuuma rungu rwa wathani wa Ngeretha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, the NAC was banned by the British colonial authorities, but it continued to operate underground.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 1953, thirikari ya Ngeretha nĩ yaaninire kĩama kĩa NAC, no kiama kĩu nĩ gĩathire na mbere na kũruta wĩra na hitho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1961, the NAC was legalized and renamed the Malawi Congress Party (MCP).
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 1961, kĩama kĩa NAC nĩgĩetĩkĩririo kĩrute wĩra na gĩgĩcenjio rĩtwa gĩgĩtuĩka Malawi Congress Party (MCP).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The MCP won the first general elections held in Malawi in 1964, and Dr. Banda became the first Prime Minister of Malawi.
entries.translation: Kĩama kĩa MCP nĩkĩo kĩahotanire ithurano cia mbere cia bũrũri wa Malawi mwaka-inĩ wa 1964, na Ndagĩtari Banda agĩtuĩka mũtongoria wa mbere wa bũrũri ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1966, Malawi became a republic, with Dr. Banda as the first President.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 1966, Malawi ĩgĩtuĩka bũrũri wa demokrasi, Ndagĩtarĩ Banda arĩ Mũtongoria wa mbere wa bũrũri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Banda ruled Malawi as a one-party state for 30 years.
entries.translation: Kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka 30, Banda agĩthamaka Malawi na thirikari ya kĩama kĩmwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a controversial figure, but he is also credited with modernizing Malawi and bringing it independence.
entries.translation: Arĩ mũtongoria warĩ na ngarari, no ningĩ nĩetĩkĩrĩkĩte tondũ nĩatũmire Malawi ũtuĩke bũrũri wa kĩrĩu na akĩrehe wĩyathi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The physicians, who are members of the Southern Medical Association, say that the firm's building was not properly ventilated and that the employees were exposed to harmful chemicals.
entries.translation: Arigitani acio, arĩa marĩ a kĩama kĩa Southern Medical Association, moigĩte atĩ nyumba cia kambuni ĩyo citiahĩtũkagia rĩera wega na atĩ aruti a wĩra nĩmagucagia rĩera rĩna ndawa njũru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We were concerned about the health of the employees at this firm," said Dr. Raymond Neal-Kennedy, a spokesman for the SMA.
entries.translation: Mwaria wa SMA, Ndagĩtari Raymond Neal-Kennedy, augĩte, "Twarĩ na nganja mũno nĩ ũndũ wa ũgima wa mwĩrĩ wa aruti a wĩra kambuni-inĩ ĩyo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "The building was not up to code and the employees were being exposed to dangerous chemicals. We had no choice but to shut the firm down."
entries.translation: "Nyumba ĩyo ndĩathingatĩte mawatho marĩa mendekanaga na aruti a wĩra nĩmagucagia rĩera rĩna ndawa njũru. Tũtiarĩ na ũndũ ũngi wa gwĩka tiga kũhinga kambuni ĩyo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The architecture firm, which has not been named, has denied the allegations.
entries.translation: Kambuni ĩyo ya ũthondeki wa mĩako, ĩrĩa ĩtagwetetwo, nĩ ĩreganĩte na ũhoro ũcio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The firm's owner, Mr. Ishq Kasawa, says that the building was properly ventilated and that the employees were not exposed to any harmful chemicals.
entries.translation: Mwene kambuni ĩyo, Ishq Kasawa, augĩte atĩ nyũmba ĩyo nĩyahĩtukagia rĩera rĩa kũigana na atĩ aruti a wĩra matiagucagia rĩera rĩna ndawa njũru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We are disappointed by the actions of the SMA," said Mr. Kasawa.
entries.translation: Kasawa athiĩte na mbere na kuuga, "Nĩ tũiguĩte ũũru mũno nĩ ũndũ wa makinya marĩa moetwo nĩ SMA."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We believe that we have been unfairly targeted. Our building is safe and our employees are healthy."
entries.translation: "Tũretĩkia atĩ nĩ kuorotwo tuorotetwo na njĩra itagĩrĩire. Nyumba iitũ nĩ njega na aruti aitũ a wĩra mena ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The SMA says that it will continue to investigate the matter and that it will take further action if necessary.
entries.translation: SMA yugite atĩ nĩ ĩgũthiĩ na mbere na gũthuthuria ũndũ ũcio na nĩ ĩkuoya makinya mangĩ marĩa magĩrĩire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Libyan Civil War is an ongoing armed conflict in Libya that began in 2011 with the overthrow of Muammar Gaddafi's government.
entries.translation: Mbaara ya Kĩndũrĩrĩ Bũrũrinĩ wa Libya ĩkoretwo ĩgĩthiĩ na mbere bũrũrinĩ ũcio kuuma mwaka-inĩ wa 2011 rĩrĩa thirikari ya Muammar Gaddafi yahagũrirwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, the Libyan House of Representatives (HoR) was elected in the eastern city of Tobruk, but the HoR has been unable to exercise effective control over the country.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 2014, Kĩama kĩa Libyan House of Representatives (HoR) nĩgĩathuurirwo tauni-inĩ ya irathĩro ya Tobruk, no HoR nĩ ĩremetwo kũrugamĩrĩra bũruri na njĩra njega.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, the Government of National Accord (GNA) was formed in Tripoli under the auspices of the United Nations, but the GNA has been unable to gain control of the country's eastern regions.
entries.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 2016, Thirikari ya Ngwatanĩro ya Kĩbũrũri (GNA) nĩ yambĩrĩirio Tripoli rungu rwa ngwatanĩro ya Ũrũmwe wa Mabũrũri, no GNA ndĩhotete kũgĩa na wathani wa icigo cia mwena wa irathĩro wa bũrũri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The LNA, led by Khalifa Haftar, has been fighting against the GNA and its allies in the west of the country.
entries.translation: LNA, ĩtongoretio nĩ Khalifa Haftar, ĩkoretwo ĩkĩrua na GNA na arata ayo mwena wa ithuiro wa bũruri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict has led to a humanitarian crisis, with hundreds of thousands of people displaced from their homes.
entries.translation: Mbara ĩyo nĩ ĩtũmĩte andũ ngiri nyingĩ maingatwo kana moore kuuma mĩcĩĩ yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United Nations has called for an immediate ceasefire and the start of a political dialogue.
entries.translation: Kĩama kĩa Ũrũmwe wa Mabũruri nĩ kĩoete ikinya rĩa kũrugamia mbaara na kuambĩrĩria mĩario ya kĩũteti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soap opera centers around the lives of the residents of a small town.
entries.translation: Mũthako ũcio wa drama cia kĩwendo ũronania mĩtũũrĩre ya aikari a tauni ĩmwe nini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The main character, Constance, is a young woman who is struggling to come to terms with the recent death of her husband.
entries.translation: Mũthaki mũnene, Constance, nĩ mũtumia mwĩthĩ ũrĩa ũratangĩka akĩgeria gwĩtĩkĩra ũhoro wa gĩkuo kĩa mũthuri wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is left to raise her two young children on her own, and she is struggling to find a way to handle her grief.
entries.translation: Atigĩtwo akĩrera ciana ciake igĩrĩ nini, na nĩaragiyĩka mũno akĩgeria gũtangĩkĩra ihooru rĩake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Constance meets a man named Frederick at the grocery store.
entries.translation: Mũthenya ũmwe-rĩ, Constance agacemania na mũndũrũme wĩtagwo Frederick nduka-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Frederick is a kind and compassionate man, and he offers Constance his support.
entries.translation: Frederick nĩ mũthuri mwega ũrĩ tha, kogwo akerutĩra kũhe Constance ũteithio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance begins to develop feelings for Frederick, but she is hesitant to start a new relationship because she is still grieving the loss of her husband.
entries.translation: Constance akaambĩrĩria kũigua akĩmwenda Frederick, no agetigĩra kwambĩrĩria ndũgũ ingĩ ya kĩwendo tondũ kĩeha gĩa gũkuĩrwo nĩ mũthuri wake kĩrĩ o ho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, Constance decides to give Frederick a chance.
entries.translation: Thutha mũtheri, Constance agatua itua rĩa kũhe Frederick kamweke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She starts dating him, and she quickly falls in love with him.
entries.translation: Akambĩrĩria gũthiĩ na mũthuri ũcio, na thutha wa kahinda kanini akambĩrĩria kũmwenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Frederick helps Constance to heal from her grief, and he gives her the strength to raise her children on her own.
entries.translation: Frederick agateithia Constance kũhona kumana na kĩeha kĩa gũkuuĩrwo, na akamũhe hinya wa kũrera ciana ciake arĩ wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance and Frederick get married, and they have a happy life together.
entries.translation: Constance na Frederick makahikania na makagĩa na ũtũũro ũrĩ na gĩkeno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They raise their children together, and they support each other through good times and bad.
entries.translation: Makarera ciana ciao marĩ hamwe na magathĩĩ na mbere na gũteithanagia maũndũ-inĩ mega na moru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance is grateful for Frederick's love and support, and she knows that she will never be able to thank him enough for everything he has done for her.
entries.translation: Constance agakenagĩra mũno wendo na ũteithio wa Frederick, na nĩ amenyaga atĩ ndangĩhota kũmũcokeria ngatho nĩ ũndũ wa maũndũ mothe marĩa amwĩkĩire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soap opera ends with a message of hope.
entries.translation: Thenema ĩyo ya kĩwendo ĩgathira na ndũmĩrĩri ya mwĩhoko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the twentieth century drew to a close, computers and electronics were becoming increasingly intertwined.
entries.translation: Karine ya mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ ĩgĩthĩĩ gũthira, kompiuta na indo cia thitima nĩciambĩrĩirie kũĩngĩrana mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early days of computing, these two fields were largely separate.
entries.translation: Matukũ-inĩ ma mbere ma kompiuta, maũndũ macio meeri nĩmatiganĩte mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Computers were large, expensive machines that were used for scientific and military purposes.
entries.translation: Kompyuta ciarĩ indo nene na cia goro ciahũthagĩrũo maũndũ-inĩ ma sayansi na ma mbaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Electronics were used in a variety of consumer products, such as radios, televisions, and telephones.
entries.translation: Indo cia thitima ciahũthagĩrwo indo-inĩ ngũrani cia mahũthĩro, ta redio, TV na thimũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.
entries.translation: O na kũrĩ ũguo, rĩrĩa kompiuta ciambĩrĩirie gũtuĩka nini na cia raithi, nĩ ciaambĩrĩirie kũhũthĩrũo maũndũ-inĩ maingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to a blurring of the lines between computers and electronics.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũcio nĩ waninire mĩhaka ĩrĩa yarĩ ho gatagatĩ ka kompiuta na indo ingĩ cia thitima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũmwe wa bata mũno wĩgiĩ kompiuta na indo cia thitima warĩ gũthondekwo kwa kompiuta ya mũndũ kĩũmbe (PC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.
entries.translation: PC yaambĩrĩirie kũhũthĩrwo mwaka-inĩ wa 1970, na ica ikuhi ĩkĩgĩa ngumo na ĩkĩambĩrĩria kũhũthĩrwo nĩ andũ kĩũmbe o hamwe na biacara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.
entries.translation: PC ciathondeketwo irĩ ciakũhũthĩrwo micii-inĩ na wabici-inĩ, no ica ikuhĩ ikĩanjia kũhuthĩrwo kũndũ kũngĩ, ta macukuru-inĩ na nyũmba-inĩ cia mabuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.
entries.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa PC gũkorwo ĩriĩ huthu gũkuua na ya kũhũthĩrwo kũndũ kuingĩ, ĩgĩtuĩka kĩndũ kĩega gĩa kũhũthĩrwo maũndũ-inĩ maingĩ, ta gũthondeka mĩandĩko na gũthaka mĩthako ya video.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The development of the PC also led to the development of a new industry: the software industry.
entries.translation: Ningĩ gũthondekwo kwa PC nĩgwatũmire kũgie na rũhonge rweru: rũhonge rwa gũthondeka programu cia kompiuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Software companies created programs that could run on PCs, and these programs quickly became essential tools for PC users.
entries.translation: Kambuni cia programu cia kompiuta igĩthondeka programu irĩa ingĩahuthĩkire thĩĩnĩ wa PC, na programu icio ĩgĩtuĩka cia bata mũno harĩ arĩa mahũthagĩra PC.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The satisfaction of a perfect touch was something that Aida had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Aida ndakoretwo acemanĩtie na mũndũ ũkũmũhutia na njĩra ya mwanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been with many men, but none of them had ever been able to give her the kind of pleasure that she craved.
entries.translation: Nĩ aakoretwo na athuri aingĩ, no gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wao wahotete kũmũhe gĩkeno kĩrĩa eriragirĩa mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had often wondered if she was simply too demanding, or if she was just meant to be alone.
entries.translation: Kaingĩ nĩ eyuragia kana nĩwe wendaga maũndũ maingĩ mũno, kana hihi abataire gũikaraga arĩ o wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hakim was different from any man she had ever met before.
entries.translation: Hakimu aarĩ ngũrani mũno na arũme arĩa angĩ aakoretwo acemanĩtie nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was kind, gentle, and he seemed to understand her in a way that no one else ever had.
entries.translation: Aarĩ mũtugi, mũhoreri, na nĩ onekaga ta aamũtaũkagũo na njĩra ĩrĩa gũtarĩ mũndũ ũngĩ wamũtaũkĩtũo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took his time with her, exploring her body with a tenderness that made her melt.
entries.translation: Agiikara o kahinda, agĩthuthuragia mwĩrĩ wa mũtumia ũcio na wendo ũria watũmaga ngoro yake ĩhorere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when he finally touched her in that special way, she felt a wave of pleasure wash over her that was unlike anything she had ever felt before.
entries.translation: Na rĩrĩa mũthuri ũcio aamũhutirie na njĩra ĩyo ya mwanya, mũtumia ũcio nĩ aaiguire akenete mũno na ũndũ ũcio warĩ ngũrani na ũrĩa aaiguĩte mbere ĩyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was as if her body had been waiting for his touch all along.
