entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She felt complete, whole, and for the first time in her life, she knew what it was to be truly satisfied.
entries.translation: Akĩigua aiganĩire mũno, na kwa ihinda rĩa mbere mũtũuũrĩre-inĩ wake, akĩmenya ũrĩa kũiganĩra na ma gũtarĩĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As Hakim continued to touch her, she felt herself losing control.
entries.translation: O ũrĩa Hakim aathiaga na mbere kũmũhutia, nĩ aaiguaga ta atarĩ na ũhoti wa kwĩgirĩrĩria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her body was on fire, and she could feel the tension building inside of her.
entries.translation: Mwĩrĩ wake waakanaga mwaki, na nĩ aiguaga ũkĩongerereka o kuongerereka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that she was about to come, and she wanted it more than anything she had ever wanted before.
entries.translation: Nĩ amenyaga atĩ nĩ akuhĩrĩirie mũno gũkinya gacũmbĩrĩ karia atũrĩte erirĩirie gũkinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime pilgrimage to Mecca, Saudi Arabia, that is required of all Muslims who are physically and financially able to make the journey.
entries.translation: Hajj nĩ rũgendo rwa riita rĩmwe mũtũũrĩre-inĩ rwa gũthĩĩ Mecca, Saudi Arabia, rũrĩa rũbataire gũthio nĩ Aithĩramu othe arĩa mehotete kĩmwĩrĩ na kĩmbeca.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilgrimage is one of the five pillars of Islam, and it is considered to be the most important spiritual journey a Muslim can make.
entries.translation: Rũgendo rũi nĩ rũmwe rwa itugĩ ithano cia ndini ya gĩithĩramu, na nĩ ruo rũgendo rwa bata mũno rwa kĩrooho harĩ mũithĩramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj takes place over five days in the Islamic month of Dhu al-Hijjah.
entries.translation: Hajj ĩthiaga na mbere kwa ihinda rĩa thikũ ithano mweri-inĩ wa Giĩthĩramu wa Dhu al-Hijjah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During the hajj, pilgrims perform a series of rituals that commemorate the life of Prophet Muhammad and the prophets who came before him.
entries.translation: Hĩndĩ ya hajj, arũmĩrĩri a ndini ĩyo nĩ mekaga maũndũ ma kũririkana Mũnabii Muhammad na anabii arĩa maariĩ mbere yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj is a physically and emotionally demanding journey, but it is also a time for Muslims to come together in worship and to reflect on their lives.
entries.translation: Hajj nĩ rũgendo rũritũ kĩmwĩrĩ na kĩmeciria, no ningĩ nĩ ihinda rĩega rĩa arũmĩrĩri a ndini ya Gĩithĩramu kũgomana mathathaiye na mecuranie ũhoro wa mĩtũũrĩre yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a chance to renew their faith and to reaffirm their commitment to Islam.
entries.translation: Nĩ mweke wa kwerũhia wĩtikio wao na gwĩkĩra hinya wĩyamũrĩri wao wa kũrũmĩrĩra ndini ya gĩithĩramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For many Muslims, the hajj is a life-changing experience.
entries.translation: Harĩ Aithĩramu aingĩ, hajj nĩ ũndũ wa kũgarura mĩtũũrĩre yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time to leave behind the stresses of everyday life and to focus on their spiritual journey.
entries.translation: Nĩ ihinda rĩa gũtiga na thutha mĩtangĩko ya o mũthenya na gwĩcurania ũhoro wa maũndũ ma kĩrooho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is the freedom of communication and expression through mediums including printed media and the internet.
entries.translation: Wĩyathi wa kũheana mohoro nĩ wĩyathi wa kwaranĩria na kwĩyaria kũhĩtũkĩra njĩra ta iria ikoragwo na ũhoro mwandĩke na intaneti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fundamental human right recognized by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and reaffirmed in Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
entries.translation: Nĩ kĩhooto kĩa bata harĩ mũndũ kĩrĩa kĩandĩkĩtwo ni Gĩcunjĩ kĩa 19 kĩa Watho wa Thĩ Yothe wa Ihooto cia Ũmũndũ na gĩgekĩrwo hinya nĩ Gĩcunjũ kĩa 19 kĩa Kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Thĩ Yothe kĩa Ihooto cia Andũ na cia Ũateti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The right to freedom of expression is recognized as a necessary precondition for the enjoyment of all other human rights.
entries.translation: Kĩhooto kĩa wĩyathi wa kwĩyaria nĩ kĩmenyekanĩte atĩ nĩkio mũthingi wa mũndũ gũkenera ihooto irĩa ingĩ ciothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is essential for a healthy democracy.
entries.translation: Wĩyathi wa kũheana mohoro nĩ wa bata mũno hari kũrũmbũiya demokrasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows citizens to access information and to hold their government accountable.
entries.translation: Ũteithagia raiya gũkinyĩra mohoro na gũthingata thirikari yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also helps to ensure that all voices are heard, and that the public is informed about important issues.
entries.translation: Ningĩ nĩ ũteithagia gũtigĩrĩra atĩ andũ othe nĩ maiguo na mũingĩ nĩ ũramenyithio maũndũ ma bata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been growing threats to freedom of the press around the world.
entries.translation: Mĩaka-ini ya ica ikuhi, nĩ gũkoretwo na mogwati mang'etheire wĩyathi wa kũheana mohoro mabũrũri-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Governments have been using laws to restrict the media, and journalists have been harassed and attacked.
entries.translation: Thirikari nĩ ĩkoretwo ĩkĩhũthĩra mawatho kũgirĩrĩria kambuni cia mohoro na aandĩki a mohoro nĩ makoretwo makĩnyarirwo na gũtharĩkĩrwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These threats are a serious concern, and they need to be addressed.
entries.translation: Mogwati maya nĩ maritũ mũno na nĩ marabatara kũrorwo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all stand up for freedom of the press.
entries.translation: Ithuothe no mũhaka tũrũĩrĩre wĩyathi wa kũheana mohoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must defend the right of journalists to report the news without fear of reprisal.
entries.translation: No mũhaka tũgitĩre kĩhooto kĩa andĩki a mohoro gĩa kũheana mohoro mategwĩtigĩra kũherithio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must also support independent media outlets, and we must encourage people to read and share news from a variety of sources.
entries.translation: Ningĩ no mũhaka tũnyite mbaru kambuni cia mohoro iria ciirũgamĩrĩire, na no mũhaka twĩkĩre andũ hinya nĩ getha mahote gũthoma na gũtambia mohoro kuuma kũndũ ngũrani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is a precious right.
entries.translation: Wĩyathi wa kũheana mohoro nĩ kĩhooto kĩa goro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all do our part to protect it.
entries.translation: No mũhaka ithuothe tũnyite itemi rĩa kũũgitĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns are making it more difficult to grow crops in some areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Mogarũrũku ma gĩthimi kĩa mbura na ũrugari kwambata nũ maratũma ũkorwo arĩ ũndũ mũritũ kũhanda mĩmera icigo-inĩ imwe, na hindi o ĩyo magatũma kũgĩe na mĩeke mĩerũ ya ũrĩmi icigo-inĩ ingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The overall effect is that the global agricultural system is becoming more complex and less predictable.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũcio ũratũma maũndũ ma ũrĩmi thĩĩnĩ wa thĩ makorwo marĩ maritũ na matakũmenyeka ũrĩa makahaana rũciũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.
entries.translation: Ũmwe wa moimĩrĩra ma ĩmwe kwa ĩmwe ma ũgarũrũku wa rĩera harĩ ũrĩmi nĩ wongerereku wa maũndũ marĩa marehago nĩ rĩera rĩũru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.
entries.translation: Ihinda rĩa ũrugarĩ mũingĩ, ng'aragu, ithingithia, na ihuhũkanio no ithũkie mĩgũnda na mahiũ, na itũme arĩmi magĩe na mathĩna ma gũtwara magetha mao thoko-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.
entries.translation: Rĩmwe na rĩmwe, maũndũ macio no matũme magetha mothe mathire, ũndũ ũrĩa ũrehaga ng'aragu ya irio na kwongerereka kwa thogora wa irio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.
entries.translation: Hamwe na moimĩrĩra moru ma rĩera, ũgarũrũku wa rĩera no ũracũngĩrĩra mogarũrũku ma gĩthimi gĩa kawaida kĩa ũrugarĩ na mbura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Mogarũrũku macio maratũma ũkorũo ũrĩ ũndũ mũritũ kũrĩma mĩmera ĩmwe icigo-inĩ imwe, na ihinda-inĩ o rĩu magatũma kũgĩe na mĩeke mĩerũ ya ũrĩmi icigo-inĩ ingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was driving home from work one day when I got cut off by another driver.
entries.translation: Ndatwarithagia ngari mũthenya ũmwe ngĩinũka kuuma wĩra-inĩ rĩrĩa ndereva ũngĩ aingĩrire mwena wakwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so angry that I started tailgating him and flashing my lights.
entries.translation: Nĩndarakarire mĩno nginya ngĩambĩrĩria kũmũrũmĩrĩra ngĩakagia matawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He just kept driving slower and slower, and I was getting more and more frustrated.
entries.translation: Nake athiaga na mbere na gũtwarithia ngari kahora na niĩ ngĩthiĩ na mbere na kũrakara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, I couldn't take it anymore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I pulled up next to him and started yelling at him.
entries.translation: Ngĩrũgamia ngari yakwa hakuhĩ na yake na ngĩambĩrĩria kũmũnegenera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He rolled down his window and started yelling back at me.
entries.translation: Agĩikũrũkia gĩcicio gĩake na akĩambĩrĩria kũnegenera o na niĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both so angry that we were shaking.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other driver pulled over to the side of the road, and I followed him.
entries.translation: Ndereba ũcio ũngĩ akĩrũgamia ngari mwena-inĩ wa barabara, na niĩ ngĩmũrũmĩrĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We got out of our cars and started yelling at each other even louder.
entries.translation: Tũkiuma ngari-inĩ ciitũ na tũkĩambĩrĩria kũgũthũkanĩra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so close to hitting him that I could smell his breath.
entries.translation: Ndakuhĩrĩirie mũno kũmũgũtha ũũ atĩ nĩndaiguaga mĩhũmũ yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, a police car pulled up.
entries.translation: Na o rĩrĩ ndĩreciria atĩ maũndũ matingĩthũka makĩria, ngari ya borithi ĩkĩrũgama harĩa twarĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officer got out of his car and asked us what was going on.
entries.translation: Mũthigari akiuma ngari-inĩ na agĩtũũria nĩ kĩ kĩrathiĩ na mbere.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both told him our sides of the story, and he started writing us a ticket.
entries.translation: Ithuerĩ tũkĩmũtarĩria o mũndũ riita rĩake, na akĩambĩrĩria gũtwandĩkĩra mahĩtia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was walking back to my car, I realized that I had learned my lesson.
entries.translation: Na rĩrĩa ndacokaga ngari-inĩ yakwa, ngĩmenya atĩ nĩ nderuta ũndũ wa bata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Road rage is never worth it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not worth getting angry over, and it's not worth getting a ticket.
entries.translation: Ti mega ona hanini na ti ũndũ wa gũtũma wandĩkĩrwo mahĩtia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful river that flowed through a lush forest.
entries.translation: Hĩndĩ ĩmwe nĩ kwarĩ na rũũĩ rũthaka mũno rwahĩtũkĩire kũndũ mũtitũ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was home to many creatures, including fish, frogs, turtles, and birds.
entries.translation: Rũũĩ rũu rwarĩ mũciĩ wa nyamũ nyingĩ, ta thamaki, ciũra, nguru na nyoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was also a popular spot for humans to swim, fish, and relax.
entries.translation: Rũũĩ rũu ningĩ nĩ rwarĩ handũ hega mũno ha andũ gũthambĩra, gũtega thamaki, na kũhurũka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young girl named Lily was playing near the river when she saw a turtle caught in a fishing net.
entries.translation: Mũthenya ũmwe-rĩ, kairĩtu kanini getagwo Lily gathakaga hakuhĩ na rũũĩ rũu rĩrĩa konire nguru ĩnyitĩtwo nĩ neti ya gũtega thamaki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to help the turtle, so she ran home to get her father.
entries.translation: Lily nĩamenyaga atĩ no mũhaka ateithie nguru ĩyo, kogwo agĩteng'era mũciĩ gwĩta ithe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily's father helped her to free the turtle, and the two of them returned to the river.
entries.translation: Ithe wa Lily nĩamũteithirie gũteithũra nguru ĩyo na eerĩ magĩcoka rũũĩ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The turtle thanked Lily for saving her life, and Lily promised to always be kind to animals.
entries.translation: Nguru ĩgĩcokeria Lily ngatho nĩ ũndũ wa kũmĩteithũra, nake Lily agĩtua itua rĩa gũteithagia nyamũ hĩndĩ ciothe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily continued to visit the river often, and she always made sure to look out for any animals that might be in danger.
entries.translation: Lily nĩ aathire na mbere na gũceera rũũĩ-inĩ, na hĩndĩ ciothe nĩatigagĩrĩra atĩ nĩarora kana kũrĩ na nyamũ ĩrĩ ũgwati-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Lily saw a group of boys throwing rocks at the fish in the river.
entries.translation: Mũthenya ũmwe Lily nĩ onire gĩkundi gĩa tũhĩĩ tũkĩhũũra thamaki na mahiga rũũĩ-inĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to stop them, so she ran up to the boys and told them that what they were doing was wrong.
entries.translation: Lily akĩmenya atĩ no mũhaka ameere matige, kogwo agĩteng'era na kũrĩa maarĩ na akĩmeera atĩ ũguo mareka nĩ ũũru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boys were surprised to hear this from Lily, but they listened to her and stopped throwing rocks.
entries.translation: Tũhĩĩ tũu nĩ twagegire nĩ ciugo icio cia Lily, no nĩtwamũthikĩrĩirie na tũgĩtiga gũikia mahiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What is the meaning of becoming a queen?" asked the young woman.
entries.translation: "Gũtuĩka mũtumia mũthamaki nĩ kuuga atĩa?" mũtumia ũcio mwĩthĩ akĩũria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It is to learn to accommodate all that is," said the old woman.
entries.translation: Nake Mũtumia ũcio mũkũrũ akĩmũcokeria atĩrĩ: "Nĩ kwĩruta kũiguana na maũndũ marĩa mothe marĩ kuo".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To hold in your heart the beauty and the pain, the joy and the sorrow, the light and the darkness.To see the world as it is, and to love it nonetheless."
entries.translation: "Gwĩtĩkĩra ngoro-inĩ yaku ũthaka na ruo, gĩkeno na kĩeha, ũtheri na nduma. Kuona thĩĩ ũrĩa ĩtarĩ na kũmĩenda o ũguo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But how can I do that?" asked the young woman. "The world is so full of suffering."
entries.translation: "No ingĩkĩhota atĩa gwĩka ũguo" mũtumia ũcio mwĩthĩ akĩũria. "Thĩ ĩiyũire mĩnyamaro."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, it is," said the old woman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But it is also full of beauty. And it is our task to find the beauty in the suffering, and to let it transform us.
entries.translation: "No ona kũrĩ ũguo thĩ nĩ ĩiyũire ũthaka mũingĩ. Na nĩ wĩra wiitũ gũcaria ũthaka thĩĩnĩ wa mĩnyamaro, na kũrekereria ũthaka ũcio ũtũgarũre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "When you become a queen, you will have power.
entries.translation: "Rĩrĩa watuĩka mũtumia mũthamaki, ũgĩaga na hinya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But power is not a thing to be used for your own gain.
entries.translation: Ĩndĩ hinya ti kĩndũ gĩa kwĩguna nakĩo we mwene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a responsibility to be used for the good of others.
entries.translation: Nĩ ũigĩrĩriki wa kĩguna arĩa angĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You must learn to use your power to heal the world, not to harm it.
entries.translation: No mũhaka wĩrute kũhũthĩra hinya waku kũhonia thĩ, no ti kũmĩthũkia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You must also learn to be humble.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A queen is not above others, but she is also not below them."
entries.translation: Mũtumia mũthamaki ndakoragwo arĩ igũrũ rĩa arĩa angĩ, no ningĩ ndakoragwo rungu rwao."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fielding side tries to prevent this by stopping the ball with their own bats, with their hands or with the wicket itself and then throwing the ball back to the bowler.

entries.english: He also imposed economic sanctions on Iran.

entries.english: The Iranian government released the hostages on January 20, 1981, just minutes after Ronald Reagan was sworn in as President of the United States.

entries.english: The noble steed, a symbol of strength and grace, has been a mainstay of human civilization for millennia.
entries.translation: Mbarathi nĩ nyamũ igũcagĩrĩria andũ nĩ ũndũ wa ũthaka na hinya wacio, na ikoretwo irĩ nyamu cia bata mĩtũũrĩre-inĩ ya andũ kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka mĩingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the battlefields of antiquity to the modern racetrack, horses have played a vital role in our history.
entries.translation: Kuuma mbaara-inĩ cia tene nginya mathako-inĩ ma kĩrĩu, mbarathi nĩ ĩkoretwo ĩkĩnyita itemi rĩa bata thĩinĩ wa historĩ iitũ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is it about horses that makes them so special?
entries.translation: No nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmaga mbarathi ikorũo irĩ cia mwanya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What is it that draws us to these magnificent creatures?
entries.translation: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũgucagĩrĩria kũrĩ ciumbe icio cia magegania?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps it is their beauty, with their sleek coats and flowing manes.
entries.translation: Hihi no gũkorwo nĩ ũthaka wacio, ngozi yacio njororo na mũreera kĩrorerwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps it is their strength, as they can carry us on their backs for miles.
entries.translation: No kũhoteke nĩ hinya wacio, tondũ no ĩtũkuue na mũgongo mairo nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or perhaps it is their intelligence, as they are capable of learning a wide variety of tasks.
entries.translation: Kana hihi nĩ uugĩ wacio, tondũ no ĩhote kwĩruta maũndũ maingĩ.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whatever the reason, there is no denying the bond that exists between humans and horses.
entries.translation: Gũtekũmakania gĩtũmi nĩ kĩrĩkũ, hatirĩ ũndũ ta nganja atĩ ndũgũ ya mũndũ na mbarathi nĩ ya mwanya mũno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are truly partners in life, and their companionship is a gift to be cherished.
entries.translation: Nĩ arata a hakuhĩ mũtũũrĩre-inĩ na thiritũ yao nĩ kĩheo twagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũtũgĩria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most remarkable things about horses is their ability to sense our emotions.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũmwe wa magegania wĩgiĩ mbarathi nĩ ũhoti wacio wa kũmenya ũria tũraigua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can tell when we are happy, sad, or scared, and they will often respond in kind.
entries.translation: Nĩ imenyaga rĩrĩa twĩna gĩkeno, kĩeha kana guoya, na kaingĩ ona nĩ ĩtuonagia wendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them ideal companions for people who are lonely or who need emotional support.
entries.translation: Ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũtũmaga ĩkorwo ĩrĩ arata a hakuhĩ kũrĩ andũ arĩa mena ihooru kana arĩa marabatara kũũmĩrĩrio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to their companionship, horses can also be used for a variety of purposes.
entries.translation: Makĩria ma gũkorwo ĩrĩ arata ega, mbarathi no ihũthĩrwo maũndũ-inĩ matiganĩte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be ridden for pleasure, used for work, or even raced.

entries.english: Sometimes, motivation can be hard to come by.

entries.english: But there are a few things you can do to help yourself get started.

entries.english: First, think about why you're doing the work.

entries.english: Once you know what you're working towards, it's easier to stay motivated.

entries.english: Second, break down the task into smaller steps.

entries.english: This will make it seem less daunting and more manageable.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_ki, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, give yourself rewards for completing each step.

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to ask for help if you need it.

entries.english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
entries.translation: Ngari cia gũkombora nĩ njega rĩrĩa ũracera tauni njerũ kana bũrũri ũngĩ.

entries.english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.

entries.english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.

entries.english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.

entries.english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.

entries.english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.

entries.english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.

entries.english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.

entries.english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.

entries.english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
entries.translation: Andũ arĩa Moragirwo Uganda nĩ ũndũ wa wĩtĩkio wao nĩ andũ 23 a Anglican na andũ 22 a Kanitha wa Gatoreki arĩa moragirwo gatagatĩ ka mwaka wa 1885 na 1887.

entries.english: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.

entries.english: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.

entries.english: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.
